jobs.title: Project Coordinator / PM Administrator
jobs.description:
**Code Four is looking for a highly organized Project Coordinator / PM Administrator to support our Project Management team in a fast\-paced event production and experiential environment.**

This role is ideal for someone who is strong with systems, organization, documentation, and follow\-through. You’ll work closely with our Project Managers to keep projects set up correctly, information current, logistics tracked, and documentation organized from project kickoff through closeout.

Experience with **NetSuite, Asana, and /or Flex Rental Solutions is highly preferred.**

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Set up and maintain projects in company PM and operational systems
* Enter and update project information in **NetSuite, Asana, Flex, and project management platforms**
* Populate project schedules and tasks using established templates
* Maintain accurate project data, folders, and file structures
* Track shipping, deliveries, pickups, and project logistics
* Collect and organize COIs, permits, approvals, and compliance documentation
* Assist with purchase orders, vendor information, work orders, and project documentation
* Track outstanding items and follow up with internal teams
* Coordinate information between Project Management, Creative, Graphics, Fabrication, AV, Warehouse/Logistics, and Accounting
* Prepare project status updates and reports
* Compile and organize project closeout documentation
* Support multiple Project Managers and active projects at the same time

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* 2\+ years of project coordination, project administration, operations, logistics, event production, AV, or related experience
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Comfortable working across multiple software systems
* Excellent follow\-through and ability to keep multiple projects organized
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities

**HIGHLY PREFERRED**

* **NetSuite experience**
* **Flex Rental Solutions / Flex ERP experience**
* Asana, Smartsheet, or similar project management software
* Event production, AV, experiential marketing, signage, graphics, fabrication, or scenic production experience
* Familiarity with POs, sales orders, estimates, shipping documentation, COIs, and permits

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is a **Project Coordinator / PM Administrator position**, not a senior Project Manager role. You will support Project Managers with the administrative and systems side of their projects rather than independently owning client relationships, project budgets, or onsite execution.

For someone interested in growing into Project Management, this is an excellent opportunity to learn the full lifecycle of complex event and experiential projects while working directly with an experienced production team.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

* Do you have experience with Asana?
* Do you have experience with NetSuite?
* Do you have experience with Flex Rental Solutions?

Education:

* Associate (Preferred)

Experience:

* project coordination or administrative: 2 years (Required)
* Microsoft Office: 2 years (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Huntington Beach, CA 92649 (Required)

jobs.title: Network infrastructure project coordinator
jobs.description:
Network Infrastructure Project Coordinator

**Job Summary**

Join our dynamic team as a Network Infrastructure Project Coordinator, where you will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex network infrastructure projects. This role is pivotal in ensuring seamless integration of enterprise IT solutions, optimizing network performance, and supporting organizational growth through innovative infrastructure initiatives. You will coordinate cross\-functional teams, manage project timelines, and communicate effectively with stakeholders to drive successful project outcomes. Your expertise in technical project management and IT infrastructure will empower us to maintain a resilient and scalable network environment.

**Duties**

* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of network infrastructure projects, including hardware, software, cloud computing solutions (such as AWS), and enterprise software implementations.
* Develop detailed project schedules using tools like Microsoft Project, Visio, TFS (Team Foundation Server), VersionOne, and Jira to track progress and ensure timely delivery.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams—including IT operations, software development, security, and vendor partners—to gather requirements and define project scope aligned with organizational goals.
* Manage project risks through proactive identification, analysis, and mitigation strategies in accordance with PMBOK (Project Management Body of Knowledge) standards.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), test case creation, and validation processes to ensure deliverables meet quality standards before deployment.
* Facilitate Agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban for iterative development cycles while integrating Waterfall approaches when necessary for large\-scale implementations.
* Oversee project documentation including SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) artifacts, disaster recovery plans, release management schedules, and IT governance compliance reports.

**Skills**

* Extensive experience managing technical projects within enterprise environments utilizing project management methodologies like PMBOK and Agile frameworks such as Scrum and Kanban.
* Proficiency with project management tools including Microsoft Project, SharePoint, Visio, Jira, TFS, VersionOne, and Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel).
* Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure components including networking hardware, cloud computing platforms (AWS), databases (SQL Server, Oracle), and enterprise software systems.
* Expertise in requirements gathering, analysis skills, risk management strategies, and stakeholder communication to ensure project alignment with business needs.
* Demonstrated leadership in technical project \& program management supervision with excellent organizational skills and time management abilities.
* Familiarity with SDLC processes for software development and implementation; experience with test\-driven development (TDD) and user acceptance testing procedures.
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards of quality; skilled in negotiation and team leadership to foster collaboration across diverse teams.
* Knowledge of IT governance principles including disaster recovery planning and compliance standards essential for enterprise solutions implementation.

Join us to be part of a forward\-thinking organization committed to technological excellence! Your expertise will help shape resilient networks that support our mission\-critical operations while advancing your career in a vibrant environment that values innovation and teamwork.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Purchasing Coordinator to join our procurement team. In this vital role, you will orchestrate the purchasing process, ensuring timely acquisition of materials and services that support our operational excellence. Your expertise in supply chain management, vendor communication, and procurement systems will drive efficiency and cost savings across the organization. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast\-paced environment where strategic sourcing and inventory control are key to success.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage end\-to\-end procurement activities using SAP, SAP ERP, JD Edwards, Oracle EBS, and other purchasing management systems to streamline purchasing workflows.
* Collaborate with vendors through direct negotiation and relationship management to secure optimal pricing, delivery schedules, and quality standards.
* Monitor inventory levels using inventory management systems and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) tools to ensure supply chain continuity.
* Analyze Excel data and spreadsheets for purchase trends, pricing analysis, and procurement forecasting to support strategic sourcing decisions.
* Coordinate with supply chain teams to optimize materials management, inventory control, and logistics operations.
* Support vendor communication efforts by resolving issues related to order discrepancies, delivery delays, or quality concerns.
* Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, contracts, and supplier performance metrics in accounting software and ERP systems.

**Experience**

* Proven experience working with SAP, SAP ERP, JD Edwards, or Oracle EBS in a purchasing or materials management role.
* Strong understanding of supply chain management principles including inventory control, sourcing strategies, and vendor relationship management.
* Demonstrated ability to utilize spreadsheets and Excel for data analysis related to procurement activities.
* Familiarity with procurement processes such as direct negotiation procurement and sourcing techniques.
* Experience supporting purchasing management systems technically or administratively is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of MRP systems, inventory management software like AS400 or equivalent platforms is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills for effective vendor negotiations and cross\-departmental collaboration.

Join us as a Purchasing Coordinator to be at the forefront of our supply chain operations! Bring your expertise in procurement systems and vendor relations to help us achieve operational excellence while enjoying a vibrant work environment dedicated to your growth and success.

Pay: $18\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Seasonal Live Content Correspondents Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
The NFL Live Content Correspondents (LCC) Program is seeking an experienced Coordinator to join their team in supporting 100\+ LCC contractors in the weekly capture and delivery of gameday and event content across the NFL social ecosystem (in direct partnership with social leads at all 32 Clubs). This position will be focused on the logistical and operational functions in the capture and real\-time distribution of all LCC generated content. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast\-paced, everchanging content production environment that incudes shifting priorities and the need to remain calm under pressure. Organizational skills and a strong knowledge of pre\- and post\-production workflows will be invaluable.


**Responsibilities**


* Support 100\+ LCC contractors in the weekly capture and delivery of gameday and event content across the NFL social ecosystem
* Support annual staffing of LCC contributors across all relevant markets w/ associated performance management
* Lead daily communication with LCCs to ensure a seamless production workflow
* Coordinate with the Player Social team to continue to scale LCC content creation opportunities in collaboration with NFL players
* Collaborate closely with other internal stakeholders to execute with LCCs around tentpole events (e.g. Super Bowl, Combine, Draft, Pro Bowl, etc.)
* Stay up to date with industry standards and best practices
* Thoroughly track the LCC program’s activity in partnership with key groups including: publishing of LCC content, consumption / engagement of LCC content, attributable revenue, etc.
* Consistently and reliably communicate information to key stakeholders across internal and external entities.


**Required Qualifications**


* 4\-year degree preferred. BS or BA in content/film/production related field preferred.
* Thorough understanding of social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, etc.
* Advanced understanding of all Microsoft Office programs such as Word, PowerPoint, and Excel
* Thorough understanding of social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, etc.
* Strong working knowledge of the production environment, including both pre and post
* Must be able to work nights and weekends during NFL gamedays or during League events (e.g. Combine, Draft)
* Must be able to work holidays depending on NFL game schedule (including but not limited to Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year’s Eve, New Year’s Day)
* Thorough knowledge of the National Football League, associated events and storylines
* Meticulous attention to detail and high level of resourcefulness

* Minimum 1\-2 years in the production space, preferably with a background in social media responsible for content / production, but open to backgrounds in broadcast, television, or theatrical
* Strong knowledge of social, digital, and broadcast television content production dynamics and working knowledge of the equipment and technologies therein
* Experience with communication platform Slack


**Other Key Attributes / Characteristics**


* Ability to work non\-traditional hours, including nights and weekends
* Capacity to work independently with limited direction
* Strong organizational skills
* Must demonstrate exceptional problem\-solving skills

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

A leading wholesaler and distributor of petroleum products is seeking a full\-time, detail\-oriented Logistics Operations Coordinator to join its dispatch and operations team. This is an excellent opportunity for an organized, self\-motivated professional to grow within a well\-established company that offers a casual yet professional working environment.

**Schedule**

This position follows a variable schedule that includes both morning and afternoon shifts, Monday through Friday. Occasional on\-call availability is required to respond to carrier and customer inquiries during evenings and weekends.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for an organized, dedicated professional with a positive attitude who learns quickly and thrives in a fast\-paced, multitasking environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential. The ideal candidate is proactive and self\-driven — someone who takes initiative to help the team meet deadlines, deliver excellent customer service, and continuously improve processes and efficiency. This person is a flexible team player, entrepreneurial in mindset, and motivated to improve every process they touch. Strong candidates seeking to advance their career will find this a great next step.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage daily order processing, scheduling, and logistics coordination
* Maintain consistent communication with customers and transportation subcontractors to ensure delivery efficiency
* Manage and coordinate relationships with 100\+ transportation subcontractors
* Maintain and update Dispatch Optimization files to ensure ongoing accuracy
* Conduct market analysis to support operational decision\-making
* Support the Logistics Supervisor with additional tasks and projects as needed
* Take ownership of decisions and assigned responsibilities, working effectively both independently and as part of a team, with good judgment, accountability, and transparency — recognizing when to ask for help or escalate
* Communicate confidently and professionally by phone and email, proactively identifying and flagging issues, delays, and operational concerns while presenting solutions
* Develop and retain strong operational knowledge, including customers, carriers, vendors, products, processes, and key contacts

**Skills \& Abilities**

* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills, with the ability to take initiative and address issues without hesitation
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, particularly with customers, drivers, carriers, and internal teams
* Ability to learn and retain detailed operational information and apply it to daily logistics decisions
* Petroleum, fuel, transportation, or logistics industry knowledge is preferred but not required

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Teams, and Outlook)
* Experience in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment is a plus
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to multitask effectively under time pressure

**Location**

Conveniently located in Huntington Beach near the 405 Freeway, just minutes from Bella Terra. This is an in\-person position.

**Compensation \& Employment Type**

Salary is dependent on experience (DOE), starting from $23\.00 per hour. This role is intended as full\-time, though part\-time candidates may be considered.

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, domestic partner status, or medical condition.*

Pay: From $23\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

The Client Services \& Operations Coordinator plays an important role in creating an organized, responsive, and welcoming experience for both families and staff. This position serves as a key point of contact for prospective and current families, while also supporting the daily scheduling and operational needs of the tutoring center.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, an excellent verbal and written communicator, comfortable working independently, and able to think creatively when helping families find scheduling solutions. This person should have a strong understanding of our tutoring programs and services and be able to confidently educate prospective and current clients about the support we provide.

This role works closely with approximately 15 part\-time instructors each day to communicate schedule changes, prepare the center for daily operations, and ensure instructors have the information and materials they need to successfully support students. The position will also provide administrative and onboarding support to the

Director of Operations and work closely with the rest of the Lead Instructors that run the center from 4\-9 p.m. This role will also have insight into Management Meetings to ensure alignment with company wide initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Services \& Scheduling**

● Answer incoming phone calls during non\-operational hours and assist families with scheduling, program questions, and general inquiries.

● Provide an exceptional customer service experience by being responsive, professional, patient, and solution\-oriented.

● Listen carefully to each family’s needs and make every effort to accommodate their scheduling requests.

● Think creatively when offering scheduling options and identify solutions that meet the needs of both the family and the center.

● Maintain a strong understanding of our tutoring programs, services, scheduling options, and policies in order to confidently educate prospective and current clients.

● Communicate the value of our programs and help families understand which services may best meet their needs.

● Respond promptly and professionally to email inquiries and other client communications.

● Serve as a reliable point of contact for parents who have questions regarding their accounts, communicating information provided by the Accounting Department and ensuring messages are relayed accurately and professionally.

**Daily Center Operations**

● Prepare the tutoring center for the day’s activities and ensure the environment is organized, welcoming, and ready to support students.

● Coordinate with approximately 15 part\-time instructors regarding daily schedules, schedule changes, student needs, and important updates.

● Communicate schedule changes to instructors in a timely and organized manner.

● Ensure instructors have the appropriate materials and information needed for

their scheduled sessions.

● Help maintain an organized center and identify operational needs before they become challenges.

● Monitor daily operations and proactively address issues that may affect the student or client experience.

● Support lead instructors in maintaining a consistent and high level of customer service.

**Scheduling \& Systems**

● Develop a strong working knowledge of the center’s scheduling system and use it accurately and efficiently.

● Maintain accurate scheduling information and communicate changes appropriately to staff and families.

● Look for opportunities to improve scheduling processes and maximize the efficient use of staff and center resources.

● Help identify operational inefficiencies and communicate opportunities for improvement to the Director of Operations.

**New Hire \& Onboarding Support**

● Provide basic administrative support to the Director of Operations during the onboarding process for new employees.

● Communicate with new hires regarding start dates, schedules, and other important information related to their first day and completion of forms.

● Help ensure new employees have the information necessary to begin their position successfully.

● Assist with maintaining organized onboarding communication and documentation. Upload and maintain required employee forms and documentation within the payroll system.

● Coordinate and facilitate required self\-paced training and onboarding activities for new instructors.

● Support the hiring process by conducting initial candidate pre\-screenings and helping identify candidates who meet the basic qualifications for the position.

● Assist with administrative tasks related to new employee onboarding and staff readiness.

**Operational Support \& Team Communication**

● Serve as a communication bridge between families, instructors, the Accounting Department, and the Director of Operations.

● Help ensure important information is communicated accurately and in a timely manner.

● Support the Director of Operations in maintaining efficient systems and processes throughout the center.

● Identify opportunities to improve the client experience and operational efficiency.

● Assist with additional administrative and operational projects as needed.

**Required**

● Excellent verbal communication and customer service skills.

● Strong ability to communicate professionally and confidently over the phone.

● Strong written communication skills, including professional email communication.

● Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

● Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond appropriately to changing schedules and client needs.

● Comfortable learning and using scheduling and administrative software.

● Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with instructors and management.

● Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to think creatively when finding solutions for families.

● Professional, positive, and dependable attitude.

Preferred

● Previous experience in customer service, scheduli

jobs.title: Production Coordinator (Avionics)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**PRODUCTION COORDINATOR (AVIONICS)**


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Monitor, track, and move parts as required through the production flow to ensure timely delivery to the next production location
* Coordinate physical movement of parts through receiving inspection, stock rooms, purchasing, production resources, or any applicable work center within SpaceX
* Ensure parts are handled and appropriately protected within SpaceX specifications
* Coordinate off\-site processing of parts to ensure on\-time delivery as required
* Work with the planning, procurement, engineering, and production teams to ensure MRP/ERP data is and remains clean and accurate
* Assist with the resolution of incorrect system data which is driving inappropriate demand, schedules, or could result in general failure
* Analyze available data and develop metrics as required to drive optimal results
* Work with production personnel to ensure metric goals are understood
* Update and utilize target management system to drive results as applicable
* Develop and maintain reports to highlight needs, deliverables, and constraints as required for internal and customer use
* Communicate part status and estimated completion dates to leadership weekly
* Support logistics process through innovative staging of workflow as required
* Assist production leadership and project teams with action item updates as required
* Support management of material certifications as required; prevent use of un\-certified materials
* Work with production supervisors and managers to ensure all metrics driven action requirements are completed
* Support production and inventory personnel with "return to stock" and inventory purge actions
* Support purchase requisition creation for scheduled contract work as required
* Organize and maintain the physical and electronic library for production related tooling and calibration database as required
* Support projects or productivity development activities within assigned production cells


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**


* High school diploma or equivalency certificate
* 1\+ years of experience in an administrative role


**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**


* Strong computer skills, familiar with the full suite of MS Office products
* 1\+ years of Inventory experience and experience organizing files and documents
* Knowledge of MRP/ERP systems
* Experience in aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, or electronic manufacturing environment
* SQL and Tableau experience
* APICS certification


**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**


* Available shifts:  

	+ 1st shift: Monday – Friday, (5:00 AM \- 3:30 PM)
	+ 2nd shift: Monday – Friday, (1:00 PM \- 11:30 PM)
* Must be willing to work overtime, and weekends as needed
* Able to lift 25 lbs. unassisted
* Able to stand for extended periods – 8 hours min


**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**  

  

Pay Range:  

Level 1: $22\.00 \- $24\.50  

Level 2: $24\.00 \- $27\.00  

Level 3: $26\.00 \- $30\.00



Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job\-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.



Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long\-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long\-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**


* To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Office Manager / Practice Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Office Manager / Practice Operations Coordinator**
====================================================

**Full\-Time \| Hybrid — Sherman Oaks, CA**  

**Occasional West Los Angeles**  

**$21–$26/hour \+ benefits**

**WHO WE ARE**
--------------

**Built by therapists. Led by therapists. Always.**


Zeeva Behavioral Health is a woman\-owned, therapist\-owned psychotherapy practice serving clients in Sherman Oaks, West Los Angeles, and online throughout California.


We believe therapy should be **deeply human and clinically extraordinary.**


And we believe the practice behind that therapy should be built the same way.


We care deeply about our therapists. Our clients. Our people. Our spaces. Our communication. Our systems. The way someone is welcomed. The way a problem is handled. Whether we follow through on what we said we would do.


Because the details matter.


Our values are **Heart\-Centered, Dedicated to Excellence, Inspired Learning, Brave Reflection, and The Power of We.**


And one principle runs through all of them:

**Clarity is kind.**


Zeeva began six years ago during the COVID\-19 pandemic. We have built something significant, and we are continuing to build the people, systems, and infrastructure that will support our future.

**THE ROLE**
------------


We are now hiring for an **Office Manager / Practice Operations Coordinator** who loves making things work.


This is a hands\-on operations role for someone who is highly organized, notices what needs attention, follows through, and enjoys creating stronger systems.


You may move between the executive director's inbox, an onboarding process, payroll, office operations, technology, recruiting, and a marketing deadline in the same day.


You do not need to personally complete every task. You need to know how to organize the work, delegate appropriately, follow up, and make sure it gets done.


You will report to our Fractional Operations Director and work closely with our Founder/Executive Director, clinical leadership, Client Care, Admin Assistant, outside HR partner, and other partners.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**
-------------------

### **Practice Operations \+ Founder Support**

* Maintain and improve processes, systems, workflows, trackers, and recurring processes
* Track projects, deadlines, ownership, and leadership follow\-through
* Help organize and triage the founder's inbox, calendar, requests, and open loops
* Identify operational gaps and help create clearer, more reliable processes

### **People Operations \+ Recruiting**

* Oversee onboarding, offboarding, recruiting, employee documentation, and routine People Operations workflows
* Organize priorities and delegate routine administrative execution to our Admin Assistant
* Coordinate with our outside HR partner when HR expertise or judgment is needed
* Help make the employee and candidate experience warm, organized, and distinctly Zeeva

### **Payroll \+ Administrative Operations**

* Own the administrative payroll workflow, including timekeeping, PTO, approved bonuses, reimbursements, and employee changes
* Coordinate vendors, recurring administrative needs, and internal follow\-through
* Help direct and organize the work of our Admin Assistant

### **Office \+ IT**

* Keep our Sherman Oaks office organized, stocked, functional, and cared for
* Coordinate supplies, facilities, vendors, access, clinician setup, and routine technology needs
* Manage routine account setup, permissions, troubleshooting, and escalation to outside experts when needed
* Occasionally support operational needs at our West Los Angeles office

### **Marketing Coordination**

* Keep approved marketing, social media, website updates, directories, outreach, and other projects organized and moving
* Coordinate execution while leadership retains brand strategy, voice, and creative direction

### **Client Care Backup**

* Become cross\-trained in core Client Care workflows
* Provide backup support during absences or high\-volume periods as needed


Client Care is its own function and will not be the primary responsibility of this role.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**
-------------------------


You might currently be an Office Manager, Operations Coordinator, Executive Assistant, People Operations Coordinator, Recruiting Coordinator, Administrative Coordinator, Operations Associate, or simply the person everyone relies on because you make things work.


Your current title matters much less to us than how you operate.


You may be great at this if you:

* Are exceptionally organized and strong with follow\-through
* Learn technology quickly

Tacos 1986 brings the unfiltered, high\-energy experience of a Tijuana street taqueria straight to Los Angeles. You’ll work closely with our marketing team to ensure all content supports the larger marketing calendar, campaigns, promotions, partnerships, and overall brand direction. jobs.title: VA Regional Sales Representative
jobs.description:
American Armor Gloves is hiring its first VA Regional Sales Representatives to build out a dedicated sales function for VA healthcare accounts. This is a new sales team, not a new company — AAG has spent years developing the manufacturing capacity, quality systems, and early government relationships this role is built to take advantage of.


**The Opportunity**
===================



This is a new role, but it isn't a cold start. AAG has already done much of the groundwork required to sell into government and VA healthcare: compliant manufacturing, a quality system built for regulated buyers, and early relationships with VA stakeholders. What hasn't existed until now is a dedicated sales representative to develop that opportunity fully within an assigned VA region. You'll be one of the first five or six people to hold this role, working from an established foundation rather than starting from nothing.


**What You'll Own**
===================


* Sales development and account management for VA facilities, CBOCs, and healthcare systems within your assigned region.
* Relationships with the people who make purchasing decisions — Chiefs of Logistics, procurement leads, and clinical stakeholders.
* A territory pipeline you build and manage yourself, from first contact through closed business, navigating VA purchasing processes along the way.
* Ongoing account growth, including new facility penetration and deeper relationships within your region.

**What Makes You the Right Fit**
================================


* **Government or VA sales experience — required.** You should already understand how these purchasing processes work.
* **Existing relationships within VA healthcare systems — preferred.** It's a specific, relationship\-driven network, and prior experience in it shortens the learning curve.
* **Comfort managing a defined territory independently,** with real ownership over how you prioritize and run it.
* **Strong follow\-through and CRM discipline,** since accurate pipeline and forecast tracking is a core part of the role, not an afterthought.

**Compensation \& Growth**
==========================

jobs.title: Talent Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Talent Administrative Coordinator provides day\-to\-day administrative support to the Talent Manager and helps ensure that new hires and employees move smoothly through Active Learning’s onboarding and employee processes.This is a highly organized, communication\-focused administrative position. The primary responsibilities include coordinating new hire onboarding, communicating with candidates and employees, collecting and tracking required documentation, maintaining employee records and compliance trackers, assisting with employee updates, and supporting offboarding processes.The Talent Administrative Coordinator will frequently communicate with new hires, prospective employees, and current staff and must be professional, responsive, welcoming, and comfortable following up consistently regarding deadlines and outstanding requirements.This position reports directly to the Talent Manager and supports the Talent Manager in maintaining organized, accurate, and efficient Talent operations.

**Key ResponsibilitiesNew Hire Onboarding \& Communication**

* Coordinate administrative onboarding steps for new hires from the time an offer is accepted through completion of onboarding.
* Serve as a primary administrative point of contact for new hires throughout the onboarding process.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with new hires regarding required documentation, deadlines, training, orientation, and next steps.
* Send onboarding paperwork, forms, instructions, and reminders.
* Collect, review, organize, and track required new hire documentation.
* Follow up consistently with new hires regarding incomplete or outstanding requirements.
* Coordinate pre\-employment requirements such as Live Scan/background clearance, TB clearance, CPR/First Aid certifications, Mandated Reporter requirements, and other applicable documentation.
* Prepare onboarding materials and assist with new hire orientations and onboarding sessions.
* Maintain organized onboarding checklists and trackers to ensure each new hire completes requirements on time.
* Communicate onboarding status and outstanding items to the Talent Manager.

**Candidate \& Employee Communication**

* Professionally communicate with prospective employees, new hires, and current employees regarding Talent\-related administrative processes.
* Respond to routine questions regarding onboarding, documentation, required certifications, training requirements, and next steps.
* Send reminders and follow\-up communications when information or documentation is outstanding.
* Maintain a welcoming and professional tone while also clearly communicating expectations and deadlines.
* Escalate employee relations, HR, compensation, or other sensitive matters to the Talent Manager or appropriate HR representative.

**Employee Documentation \& Records**

* Maintain accurate and organized employee personnel records.
* File and update employee documents throughout the employee lifecycle.
* Review employee records regularly for missing, incomplete, or expired documentation.
* Follow up with employees regarding required updates or missing information.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling employee and candidate information.
* Ensure internal employee trackers and records remain accurate and current.

**Compliance \& Certification Tracking**

* Maintain administrative trackers for employee certifications, clearances, and required employment documentation.
* Monitor expiration dates and upcoming renewal requirements.
* Send employees reminders regarding expiring or outstanding documentation.
* Follow up until required documentation has been received.
* Provide regular updates to the Talent Manager regarding outstanding requirements.
* Escalate urgent or unresolved compliance matters when appropriate.

**Employee Changes \& Offboarding Support**

* Assist with administrative processing of approved employee changes.
* Update internal trackers and employee records following approved changes.
* Maintain documentation related to employee updates.
* Assist the Talent Manager with employee offboarding procedures.
* Prepare and organize applicable separation documentation and internal notifications.
* Update employee records and trackers following separation.
* Ensure employee files are complete and properly organized.

**Talent Administrative Support**

* Maintain Talent calendars, employee trackers, onboarding lists, spreadsheets, and administrative records.
* Prepare employee communications, forms, letters, and Talent\-related documents.
* Assist with scheduling orientations, onboarding appointments, trainings, and other Talent activities.
* Assist the Talent Manager with employee\-related projects and administrative assignments.
* Help maintain organized Talent systems, folders, files, and processes.
* Identify missing information, upcoming deadlines, or incomplete tasks and proactively follow up.
* Provide additional administrative support to the Talent Manager as needed.

**Qualifications**

* Previous administrative, onboarding, recruiting coordination, employee services, or office support experience preferred.
* Strong administrative and organizational skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating professionally with candidates, new hires, employees, and managers.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines, employees, documents, and follow\-ups simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-through and ability to stay on top of outstanding items without constant supervision.
* Ability to maintain confidential employee information.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, email, calendars, and electronic files.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office.
* Experience with onboarding or employee management systems preferred.
* ADP experience is a plus.
* Ability to work independently while understanding when an issue should be escalated to the Talent Manager.

**Administrative Coordinator (Bilingual – English/Spanish)**

**Location:** Irvine, CA  

**Company:** CMS, a division of Scopes Facility Services  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

 **About the Role**


The Administrative Coordinator plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth, efficient, and professional operation of the office by providing comprehensive administrative support to management and staff. This position requires a highly organized, proactive, and dependable individual who can manage multiple priorities, anticipate needs, coordinate requests, and maintain a high level of professionalism.


This is a fast\-paced position that requires the ability to adapt quickly and remain organized while handling frequent interruptions and changing requests. The ideal candidate is someone who is willing to learn, comfortable asking questions, receptive to feedback, and proactive about finding ways to provide support. Success in this role requires sound judgment, attention to detail, initiative, professionalism, and the ability to work collaboratively with individuals at all levels.

  

This position is required to be in\-office during regular business hours. The typical schedule is **9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday**.

 **Minimum Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or higher preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise good judgment when handling sensitive information.
* Ability to work independently while also functioning as a collaborative team member.
* Demonstrated willingness to learn new processes, systems, and responsibilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bilingual\- (English/Spanish)
* Experience in an administrative, office coordination, or office support role.
* Experience managing multiple accounts, customers, vendors, or internal departments.
* Knowledge of cleaning, facilities, maintenance, or service\-related industries.
* Knowledge of records management and confidentiality practices.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with calendar management and corporate scheduling tools.

**Responsibilities:**

**Administrative Support**

* Provide day\-to\-day administrative support to management.
* Manage and maintain calendars, appointments, meetings, and competing priorities.
* Anticipate needs and proactively assist with follow\-up items, scheduling, documentation, and communications.
* Track and coordinate management requests to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time.
* Prepare documents, correspondence, reports, spreadsheets, and other materials as requested.
* Assist with special projects and other administrative initiatives as assigned.
* Maintain a professional and organized environment that allows management and staff to work efficiently.

**Office Operations**

* Order office supplies and maintain adequate stock of essential materials.
* Coordinate vehicle and equipment maintenance, repairs, service appointments, and visits.
* Occasionally perform business\-related errands and off\-site tasks as needed, which may require driving a company vehicle or personal vehicle on behalf of the organization. Must be willing and able to drive for business purposes and maintain a valid driver’s license and required insurance.
* Submit, track, and follow up on work orders and office service requests.
* Maintain organized office records, files, supplies, equipment, and shared resources.
* Assist with coordinating workspace needs, and other operational activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve office processes, organization, and efficiency.

**Scheduling \& Coordination**

* Coordinate calendars, meetings, appointments, conference calls, and internal events.
* Schedule and prepare meeting rooms, including coordinating technology, materials, agendas, and refreshments when needed.
* Monitor work order schedules for conflicts and proactively communicate changes or potential issues.

**Communication \& Relationship Management**

* Manage phone systems, screen and direct calls, and respond to inquiries professionally.
* Draft, proofread, and distribute correspondence, emails, announcements, and other communications.
* Serve as a professional liaison between management employees, customers, vendors, and internal departments.
* Communicate requests and follow\-up items clearly while ensuring appropriate parties are kept informed.
* Handle sensitive or confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
* Maintain positive and professional relationships with employees, customers, vendors, and business partners.

**Data \& Records Management**

* Maintain accurate digital and physical records, files, reports, and documentation.
* Organize and maintain confidential information for efficient retrieval.
* Prepare basic reports, spreadsheets, summaries, and other documentation.
* Process forms, work orders, service requests, and other administrative documents as needed.
* Ensure documentation is complete, accurate, current, and properly maintained.
* Assist with data entry and maintaining internal systems and databases.

**Team \& Departmental Support**

* Provide administrative support to various departments as needed to maintain efficient operations.
* Step in to support urgent or time\-sensitive needs and help prioritize tasks based on business requirements.
* Work collaboratively across departments to resolve issues and keep projects and requests moving forward.
* Take initiative to identify what needs to be done rather than waiting for direction when appropriate.
* Ask questions and seek clarification when needed to ensure tasks are completed correctly.
* Learn new systems, processes, and responsibilities as the needs of the organization

jobs.title: 2027 MBA Summer Intern – Account Manager, US
jobs.description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income. With our launch in 1971 in Newport Beach, California, PIMCO introduced investors to a total return approach to fixed income investing. In the 50\+ years since, we have worked relentlessly to help millions of investors pursue their objectives – regardless of shifting marketing conditions. As active investors, our goal is not just to find opportunities, but to create them. To this end, we remain firmly committed to the pursuit of our mission: delivering superior investment returns, solutions, and service to our clients.


Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high\-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

**2027 MBA Summer Intern – Account Manager, US**

**Positions will be located****in PIMCO’s Newport** **Beach,** **CA Headquarters, Austin,****Texas, or New** **York, NY.**


PIMCO’s client management team is comprised of client\-facing relationship management and sales professionals (“Account Managers”) who are directly responsible for contributing to the firm’s success through a combination of client relationship management and business development. Account Managers represent PIMCO to our clients and prospective clients and seek to deliver investment solutions that leverage PIMCO’s position as one of the world’s premier fixed income investment managers.


Account Managers are investment professionals who have a broad range of responsibilities, including to:

* Build and maintain relationships across client organizations
* Educate clients about a broad set of investment strategies
* Develop a deep understanding of clients’ investment objectives, risk tolerance and organizational structure, and industry trends towards presenting compelling tailored investment solutions
* Collaborate with other PIMCO investment professionals, including Product Strategists and Portfolio Managers regarding PIMCO's product offerings and capabilities
* Effectively communicate the benefits and features of PIMCO's investment solutions in the context of client investment objectives
* Provide information about performance attribution, market performance and macroeconomic conditions, as well as outline the firm’s current economic outlook and portfolio strategy
* Identify new business opportunities within existing clients and prospective clients; develop and execute strategies to grow PIMCO's assets under management (AUM) and improve firm profitability.


Account Managers can specialize in servicing a wide range of client types, including but not limited to, endowments, investment consultants, foundations, pension funds, broker\-dealer firms, and government entities.


The Account Manager Internship offers opportunities across both our Client Management and Global Wealth Management business groups. Interns will be aligned to one of these teams and gain hands\-on experience supporting client relationships and strategic initiatives within their respective group.

**Career Development, Training and Mentoring**


Every intern begins their summer with a formal week of training. The PIMCO Fundamentals training program will provide you with the skills, knowledge and relationships that will prepare you to succeed in your internship. Throughout the summer, in addition to formal senior networking initiatives and a high business impact project, your informal training will continue as you collaborate with the full PIMCO Team on client\-related work. In addition, you will be teamed with a seasoned professional who offers guidance and mentorship throughout the internship.

**Desired Candidates Should Possess the Following Characteristics**

* Ability to articulate ideas/strategies/views clearly verbally, in writing, and during presentations
* Personable and credible; ability to influence and develop client relationships into strategic partnerships
* Passion for financial markets, macroeconomics, and investment strategy
* Strong analytical abilities; capacity to blend the quantitative with the qualitative
* Ability to work effectively with other teams and leverage expertise to benefit clients
* Ability to develop an understanding of PIMCO’s clientele and investment strategies
* Ability to own a work assignment from ideation through implementation
* Highly organized, self\-sufficient, organized, and flexible
* Have demonstrated curiosity and experience in using new emerging technologies and AI tools in your work or school projects to solve problems and drive better outcomes

**You’re eligible to apply if you:**

* Are pursuing an MBA degree with an emphasis in Finance and Economics or a related, quantitative/analytical field from an accredited, leading business school or university, or other equivalent Advanced Degree as it relates to the position.
* Must be able to begin full time employment from a PIMCO office between January 2028 – August 2028
* Must be enrolled at a university during the Fall 2027 semester (August 2027 – December 2027\)
* Are business proficient in English

**While our eligibility requirements are not flexible, we encourage you to apply even if you do not possess 100% of the desired skills outlined above.**

**The PIMCO Internship Experience:**

* The PIMCO Internship is a 10\-week program that runs from early June to mid\-August, with the expectation that you will be available for the full duration of the program
* During Week 1, you’ll participate in PIMCO Fundamentals Training, providing you with the skills, knowledge, and relationships that will prepare you for success
* Alongside your colleagues, participate in PIMCO's Global Month of Volunteering, developed to heighten the impact of our employees' worldwide volunte

jobs.title: Enterprise Security Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:
**Grow with us!**  

HCI Systems, Inc. is seeking a results\-driven, enthusiastic sales professional to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will sell enterprise\-level integrated security solutions with a focus on new construction and build strong relationships with end\-users, electrical contractors and general contractors. You will have the opportunity to prospect and cultivate new relationships, gain an understanding of our clients' needs, and secure sales opportunities. **About Us:** HCI Systems, Inc. is a renowned leader in the fire life safety and low voltage industry, providing our clients with an end\-to\-end service offering that allows them to bundle all their needs under one provider.
Responsibilities:
* Drive business growth by prospecting and cultivating new relationships and identifying and educating prospective customers about HCI's products and services.
* Be responsible for identifying customer needs and developing strategies to meet company sales objectives.
* Lead the sales process from proposal development to closing, including crafting comprehensive scopes of work, managing project scope communication, and handling change order costs.
* Serve as the primary contact for clients, ensuring strong partnerships are established and maintained before, during, and after the sales process. Oversee all aspects of customer accounts, including managing active accounts and fostering sales growth.
* Collaborate with premier partners in vertical markets, such as transportation, global/enterprise accounts, utilities, financial/banking, healthcare, datacenters, federal, state, and local governments, and K\-12 \& higher education.
* Develop business opportunities by conducting needs assessments and constructing winning proposals for system installation and service opportunities.
* Develop financial justifications, perform takeoffs, prepare estimates and proposals, make presentations, and perform the necessary follow\-up for a successful closing of the sale.
* Build market awareness through networking, presentations, event attendance, and industry associations.
* Partner with operations personnel to execute growth, development, sales, and marketing strategies.
* Achieve agreed upon sales targets and outcomes within schedule.


Qualifications:
* Associate degree or equivalent experience required; Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or engineering preferred.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of demonstrated successful sales in the security integration industry, general construction, or electrical construction industry.
* Comprehensive industry knowledge of security integration solutions and/or other related low voltage systems.
* Ability to quickly identify and qualify opportunities, as well as handle complex, large\-scale accounts and high\-value contracts.
* Experience working with electrical contractors, general contractors, consultants, engineers or end users, with the ability to read construction blueprints and wiring diagrams.
* High degree of self\-discipline and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced corporate environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, using tact and diplomacy when dealing with customers.
* Must be reliable, self\-motivated, success\-driven, with excellent organizational, negotiating and follow\-up skills.
* Proficiency in industry\-related equipment including Windows, MS Office, and customer relationship management (CRM) software.
* Applicants must meet requirements in relation to background, have a valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.
* Regular, reliable, predictable attendance.

***\*\*compensation range includes potential commissions earned on sales\*\****  

HCI Systems Inc. is a licensed C\-7, C\-10 and C\-16 low voltage systems integration contractor offering a full spectrum of services including sales, engineering, installation, service, and maintenance with over 600 employees in our seven branches. We offer fire life safety, fire suppression, fire sprinkler, access control, video management, intrusion detection, structured cable, nurse call and other related electronic detection solutions to our customers. **Why Join Us?*** **Unlimited Growth** – Our expanding product lines and markets drive consistent double\-digit growth, creating ongoing opportunities for advancement.
* **Comprehensive Benefits** – Enjoy 401(k) with matching, reduced\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible spending accounts. Additional voluntary benefits include life insurance, disability, and accident coverage.
* **Paid Time Off** – Recharge with paid holidays and our PTO plan
* **Weekly Pay** – Get paid every Friday.
* **Employee Perks** – From appreciation events and department outings to wellness programs and pet insurance, we invest in our team’s well\-being.

**E*****qual Employment Opportunity****HCI is an equal opportunity employer. We will not unlawfully discriminate against qualified applicants or employees with respect to any terms and conditions of employment and give equal opportunity considerations to applicants and employees regardless of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, related medical conditions and lactation), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, disability, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances (“Protected Classifications”). HCI will reasonably accommodate employees and applicants with disabilities as required by law, if the person is otherwise qualified to perform all the essential functions of the position safely and competently.*
Pay Range: USD $60,000\.00 \- USD $300,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Regional Events & National Account Manager
jobs.description:
Founded in 1956, the Jacuzzi® Brand has grown to become the modern\-day Jacuzzi Group, the premier manufacturer of functional products for the home and outdoor space found in more than 60 countries. Jacuzzi Bath Remodel (JBRx) is the fastest growing business unit of Jacuzzi Group with 13 successful locations launched nationwide in under 5\-years. Jacuzzi Bath Remodel combines our premium materials, knowledgeable sales team, experienced in\-house certified installers and over 60 years of proven excellence to deliver the highest standard of customer satisfaction.

**Position Summary:**


The Events \& National Account Manager owns the end\-to\-end performance of our Field Marketing Event team as well as our retail partnerships with Lowe’s, Sam’s Club, BJ’s, and Costco, serving as the primary point of accountability for revenue, lead generation, and store\-level execution across an assigned territory. This role combines field leadership, data\-driven program management, and executive\-level relationship building to maximize the productivity of every store within the program.


The successful candidate will spend significant time in stores coaching associates, equipping lead takers with the tools and training they need to succeed, and engaging both store leadership and district and regional management across our retail partners. They will translate performance data into clear, actionable business reviews and build a strategic roadmap that grows revenue from the Lowe’s, Sam’s Club, BJ’s, and Costco channels year over year.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Deliver PK trainings** to Home Depot store associates and department supervisors on a regular cadence to build product fluency, confidence, and lead\-generation behaviors.
* **Develop and refresh training content** (in\-store demos, talk tracks, leave\-behinds, and digital materials) to reflect new products, promotions, and seasonal priorities.
* **Measure training effectiveness** by tracking lead volume, quality, and conversion before and after each session, and adjust curriculum based on results.
* **Manage day\-to\-day performance** of all stores in the assigned territory, with clear weekly and monthly lead generation targets per store.
* **Lead Field Lead Generation activities** in store, including event execution, in\-aisle engagement programs, promotional displays, and associate\-driven referrals.
* **Coach lead takers** on prospecting techniques, qualifying questions, and handoff quality to drive higher set rates and sit rates downstream.
* **Identify underperforming stores** and design targeted intervention plans that include training, staffing, merchandising, and event support.
* **Advocate for the program** during Home Depot store visits, district meetings, and regional reviews, establishing our brand as a leading service provider. **Develop and sustain trusted relationships** within Home Depot Stores.
* **Create and own a strategic plan** for the Home Depot program that defines revenue targets, growth initiatives, investment priorities, and resource needs.
* **Drive revenue growth** from Field Lead Generation activities by prioritizing the highest\-ROI stores, events, and product categories.
* **Partner cross\-functionally** with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Installation teams to ensure leads convert efficiently and customer experience remains best in class.
* **Forecast and budget** field activity spend, event costs, and staffing against expected lead and revenue returns.
* **Review lead taker data** weekly to identify trends in productivity, lead quality, store mix, and event ROI.
* **Prepare and present business reviews** (weekly, monthly, and quarterly) with clear key findings, root\-cause analysis, and prioritized action items for both internal leadership and Home Depot counterparts.
* **Translate data into action** by turning insights into specific coaching plans, training topics, event adjustments, and staffing decisions.
* **Maintain accurate reporting** in CRM and lead management systems to ensure pipeline visibility and forecasting integrity.
* Other duties as assigned

**Compensation: is based on experience; $83,000\+ (Based on experience) \+ plus generous bonus structure**

  

  

**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 3–5 years of experience in field sales, retail program management, lead generation, or big\-box partnership management.
* Demonstrated track record of driving revenue growth in a retail or in\-store environment.
* Experience training, coaching, and motivating front\-line retail associates.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret lead, sales, and conversion data and translate it into a business narrative.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; comfort with CRM and lead management platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present to executive\-level retail partners.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to travel regularly to stores within the assigned territory.
* Direct experience working with The Home Depot, Lowe’s, or another national big\-box retail partner highly preferred.
* Background in home improvement, home services, or another consultative, lead\-driven sales model preferred
* Preferred experience includes developing event\-based or in\-store lead generation programs from inception.

  

**Benefits**  

* Positive work culture
* 401(k) with matching program
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative – B2B Appointment Setting
jobs.description:
**Location:** Irvine, CA

**Job Type:** Part\-Time (with opportunity to transition to Full\-Time)

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, approximately 4 hours per day (16–20 hours/week)

**Pay:** $18–$20/hour (based on experience) \+ Performance Bonus \+ Commission

**About Us**

We are an Irvine\-based company providing Advertising \& Marketing, Commercial Signage, Branding, Printing, Video Production, and Trade Show Exhibit solutions to businesses throughout Southern California.

We are looking for an energetic and persistent B2B Inside Sales / Appointment Setter who is comfortable making outbound calls, speaking with business owners and decision\-makers, and developing new sales opportunities.

**The core of this position is simple:**

**Call → Reach the Decision Maker → Identify Needs → Qualify the Opportunity → Schedule an Appointment → Follow Up**

Qualified opportunities will be supported by our Sales and Project teams through proposals, site visits, and closing.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Make outbound calls to prospective business clients using company\-provided lead lists and market resources.

2\. Use phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels to initiate conversations with potential B2B clients.

3\. Connect with business owners, managers, marketing teams, operations managers, property managers, and other relevant decision\-makers.

4\. Introduce our services, including:

(1\) Advertising \& Marketing

(2\) Social Media \& Content Creation

(3\) Video Production

(4\) Commercial Signage

(5\) Storefront \& Lobby Signs

(6\) Interior Branding \& Wall Graphics

(7\) Commercial Printing \& Event Displays

(8\) Trade Show Booths \& Exhibits

5\. Identify potential needs such as new business openings, signage projects, renovations, rebranding, marketing campaigns, social media content, events, and trade shows.

6\. Qualify potential opportunities and schedule phone calls, Zoom meetings, client meetings, or site visits for the Sales team.

7\. Maintain accurate records of conversations, client needs, and follow\-up status.

8\. Consistently follow up with previous leads and identify new sales opportunities.

**Qualifications**

1\. Comfortable with Cold Calling and speaking with new business prospects.

2\. Strong English speaking and telephone communication skills.

3\. Experience in Telesales, Inside Sales, Telemarketing, Appointment Setting, Customer Service, or Business Development is preferred.

4\. Persistent and comfortable following up multiple times when appropriate.

5\. Self\-motivated and able to work toward clear activity and sales goals.

6\. B2B Sales, Advertising, Marketing, Signage, Printing, Trade Show, Event, or related industry experience is a plus.

**Compensation \& Schedule**

**Starting Position:** Part\-Time

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday

**Hours:** Approximately 16–20 hours per week

**Base Pay:** $18–$20/hour, depending on experience

**Additional Compensation:** Performance\-Based Bonus \+ Sales Commission

Additional compensation may be earned based on qualified opportunities, appointments, and closed sales.

**How We Measure Success**

We care about call activity, but results matter more than simply making a high number of calls.

Performance will be evaluated based on the sales pipeline you help create:

Meaningful Conversations → Qualified Leads → Appointments → Quotes → Closed Sales

**Who We're Looking For**

We are not looking for someone who simply wants to complete a daily call quota.

We want someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, starting conversations with new businesses, following up consistently, and turning cold prospects into real sales opportunities.

This is not a passive customer service position.

If you enjoy talking to people, aren't afraid of cold calling, and want the opportunity to increase your income through performance, we'd like to hear from you.

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 16\.0 – 20\.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Irvine, CA 92612

AVI\-SPL is a digital enablement solutions provider who transforms how people and technology connect to elevate experiences, create new value, and enable organizations to thrive and grow. We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award\-winning managed services.  

Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. We believe that success starts with a sound team and that an inclusive and diverse workplace moves us all forward. **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

jobs.title: Inside Sales & Service Representative
jobs.description:
Hajoca Corporation is one of the country’s largest privately\-held wholesale distributors of plumbing, heating \& cooling, and industrial supplies. Founded in 1858, Hajoca is a company based on the principles of “Service, Integrity, Reliability,” and on relationships of trust and support with teammates, customers, and suppliers. Throughout its history, Hajoca has played an active role in shaping advances in plumbing. However, we attribute our success to two simple truths; a unique business philosophy and talented people. Hajoca is all about the people, who give us our advantage, and who will guide us successfully into the future.
  
  

Although Hajoca is a large company, we work in a decentralized environment where each of our locations, called Profit Centers (PCs), is run by the Profit Center Manager as if it were their own small business. A typical Profit Center is the heart of our business and consists of a warehouse, counter, sales office, and (sometimes) a showroom. Our PCs conduct business under unique trade names and offer a customized business approach, honoring what’s special about each local marketplace.
  
  

Hajoca is one of those trade names and is looking for an Inside Sales \& Service Representative at their Costa Mesa, CA location.
  
  

Pay for Inside Sales \& Service Representative is between $20 and $30 per hour at this location.
  
  

Do you take pride in providing an excellent customer experience? Are you outgoing, knowledgeable, and service\-oriented? Do you have the determination to close sales and build lasting relationships with new and existing customers? If so, we’d like you to join our team as an Inside Sales \& Service Representative.
  
  

**About the Role:**  

**You will:**  

* Meet or exceed the sales targets established by your Manager.
* Work with the Profit Center Manager to establish revenue and margin targets.
* Accurately process Sales Orders and Bids generated through telephone sales transactions.
* Assist customers who pick up their order at our Profit Center.
* Find innovative ways to grow sales with existing customers and become their trusted advisor.
* Generate sales leads that develop into new customers.
* Identify opportunities for value\-added services and articulate our solutions.
* Investigate and resolve customer problems, address pricing deductions and material returns timely and in accordance with Company policy and procedure, and follow up to ensure resolution and customer satisfaction.
* Support Counter and Outside Sales activities and all Profit Center activities as part of our Profit Center team.
* Communicate to the Profit Center Manager and Credit Manager any changes in a customer’s business that might cause a credit risk.
* Successfully complete required safety and compliance training programs as assigned.
* Perform other reasonably related duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and other management as required.


**About You:**  

* 1 year of experience in customer service or inside sales; contractor sales preferred.
* Knowledge of products sold in the Profit Center preferred.


**Our ideal candidate will also:**  

* Effectively use Microsoft Office software (Outlook, Word, Excel) to communicate via email, to maintain weekly sales plans, call reports, and customer contact files, and to analyze customer data.
* Demonstrate outstanding customer service, telephone/verbal communication, and generous listening skills.
* Demonstrate product knowledge to answer customer questions and identify opportunities to upsell or cross sell.
* Build influential relationships and trust with customers and vendors through open and interactive communication.
* Be able to ask probing questions to understand customer needs, overcome objections by recommending profitable solutions, explain our value\-added services, and ask for the order and close the sale.
* Be able to build positive working relationships and inspire teamwork with co\-workers.
* Be able to learn and operate the computer related systems used to process orders.
* Be able to learn to operate warehouse material\-handling equipment.
* Read, write, speak, and understand English.
* Be able to add, subtract, multiply, and divide, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.


**The benefits of working with us:**  

Our culture is well\-suited for exceptional people who use their talents to drive business and want to share in the financial success their efforts yield. In addition to a competitive starting wage, we offer a Profit\-Sharing Program that provides each team member with an opportunity to earn a direct share of the profits on an annual basis.
