jobs.description:
**Location:** Irvine, CA

**Job Type:** Part\-Time (with opportunity to transition to Full\-Time)

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, approximately 4 hours per day (16–20 hours/week), with flexible scheduling to accommodate client meetings, networking events, and business development activities

**Pay:** $18–$30/hour (based on experience and qualifications) \+ Commission

**About Us**

We are an Irvine\-based company providing integrated Advertising \& Marketing, Commercial Signage, Branding, Printing, Video Production, and Trade Show Exhibit solutions to businesses throughout Southern California.

Our services include:

1\. Advertising \& Marketing Services

2\. Social Media Marketing \& Content Creation

3\. Video Production \& AI\-Powered Creative Content

4\. Commercial Indoor \& Outdoor Signage

5\. Storefront \& Lobby Signs

6\. Wall Graphics \& Interior Branding

7\. Commercial Printing, Banners \& Event Displays

8\. Trade Show Booth \& Exhibit Design/Production

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a proactive, results\-driven Business Development / Outside Sales Representative who enjoys building relationships, developing new B2B accounts, and turning opportunities into revenue.

This is a new business development role. We are looking for someone who can actively open doors and build a pipeline — not simply wait for inbound leads.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Proactively develop new B2B clients throughout Orange County and Southern California through phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, in\-person visits, and networking.

2\. Attend Chamber of Commerce events, industry associations, networking functions, trade shows, expos, and other local business events.

3\. Identify and develop opportunities with businesses including:

（1） Restaurants \& Retail

（2） Property Management \& Real Estate

（3） Interior Design \& Architecture

（4） General Contractors \& Construction

（5） Healthcare \& Medical Offices

（6） Schools \& Education

（7） Professional Services

（8） Event Planners \& Trade Show Exhibitors

（9） Advertising \& Marketing Agencies

4\. Identify client needs related to advertising, marketing, social media, video production, commercial signage, interior branding, printing, and trade show exhibits.

5\. Collaborate with our creative, production, and project teams to develop solutions, prepare proposals, and move opportunities toward closing.

6\. Consistently follow up with prospects and drive opportunities through the full sales cycle: Lead → Meeting → Quote → Closed Sale.

7\. Build long\-term client relationships and identify opportunities for repeat business, referrals, and cross\-selling across our different service lines.

**Qualifications**

1\. Experience in Sales, Business Development, B2B Sales, Advertising, Marketing, Signage, Printing, Trade Shows, Exhibits, Construction, or related industries is preferred.

2\. Comfortable proactively developing new business rather than relying solely on inbound leads.

3\. Strong English communication and relationship\-building skills.

4\. Self\-motivated, organized, and able to manage prospects and follow\-ups independently.

5\. Comfortable attending local networking and business events.

6\. Existing business relationships or professional networks in Orange County / Southern California are a strong plus.

Candidates with established relationships in Chambers of Commerce, Advertising/Marketing Agencies, Property Management, Real Estate, Interior Design, Architecture, Construction, Restaurants, Retail, Healthcare, Events, or Trade Shows are especially encouraged to apply.

**Compensation \& Schedule**

**Starting Position:** Part\-Time

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday

**Hours:** Approximately 16–20 hours per week, with flexibility based on client meetings, networking events, and business development activities

**Base Pay:** $18–$30/hour, depending on experience, sales ability, and existing business relationships

**Commission:** Additional commission based on closed sales

Strong performers have the opportunity to earn significantly more through commissions.

This position will begin as Part\-Time, with the opportunity to transition into a Full\-Time role based on performance, business development results, and company growth.

**Who We're Looking For**

If you enjoy connecting with people, proactively reaching out to new clients, and earning additional income through your sales performance, we'd like to hear from you.

We are looking for someone with a true hunter mentality — someone who enjoys meeting new people, opening doors, building business relationships, and turning new conversations into real revenue.

This is not a passive sales position where you wait for leads to come in.

If you enjoy developing new business and want your income and career opportunities to grow with your sales performance, we look forward to receiving your application.

Pay: $18\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 16\.0 – 20\.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Irvine, CA 92612

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, NimbleRx
jobs.description:
**At Swoop, our mission is simple:** Improving patient outcomes. As a market leader in AI\-driven, data\-powered, and privacy\-compliant healthcare engagement, we connect the signals that drive earlier diagnosis, better treatment decisions, and sustained adherence.
  
  

Our integrated, privacy\-safe platform, enables life sciences companies to drive measurable patient and commercial outcomes with actionable intelligence — spanning patient and HCP audience targeting, community engagement, AI\-powered web solutions, coordinated omnichannel activation, and prescription fulfillment.
  
  

We believe our people are our greatest asset. Swoop fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, providing employees with rich opportunities for professional growth. This commitment to our team earned us the "Best Places to Work" recognition from Business Intelligence Group in 2025 and 2026\. We are driven by a patient\-first philosophy and passionate about leveraging technology to create a healthier future.
  
  

After becoming an independent company in 2024, Swoop experienced significant growth and demonstrated an unwavering commitment to innovation, talent development, and enhancing the patient experience. Our acquisition of MyHealthTeam in January 2025 and Nimble in May 2026 helped us further bridging the gap between healthcare brands and patients for more impactful and targeted engagement. Empowering millions of patients nationwide to connect, share resources, and access medically verified information to better manage their health. MyHealthTeam hosts the largest and most engaged patient social networks in healthcare, offering more than 70 condition\-specific communities for chronic and rare conditions. As a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform, Nimble empowers independent and regional pharmacies to deliver a modern, consumer\-friendly healthcare experience while streamlining pharmacy operations.
  
  

If you're a driven professional seeking to make a real difference in healthcare marketing at a fast\-growing, innovative company, join Swoop and help us revolutionize how brands connect with patients and HCPs.
  
  

About the role
  
  

NimbleRx is looking for a motivated and ambitious Sales Development Representative from the tech/healthcare space to join our growing Sales Team. As an SDR, you will be the first point of contact for potential pharmacy partners and play a crucial role in driving our sales pipeline.
  
  

In this role, you will be responsible for scheduling appointments for our Account Executives to demo our product for local and regional pharmacy groups. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with an ability to adapt quickly and a team player with a passion for making an impact and building a career in a SaaS sales role!
  
  

What you'll do
  
  

Drive strategic outreach (cold calling, email campaigns, etc.) to large pharmacy groups to determine decision\-makers within target pharmacies.
  
Employ effective selling techniques including research, building rapport, productive questions, and issue identification.
  
Build relationships with pharmacy owners/decision\-makers to establish trust and confidence in NimbleRx's exciting tech\-driven product.
  
Schedule product demos for Account Executives and ensure prospects are prepared and engaged for the next steps in the sales process.
  
Work closely with the Sales and Marketing teams to align messaging, strategies, and goals for optimal outreach.
  
Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, track progress, and update lead statuses in our CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system, Salesforce.
  
Develop strategic account and opportunity insights by analyzing previously closed opportunities, historical conversation notes, and customer feedback to identify patterns, barriers, and high\-potential paths to engagement.
  
Lead thoughtful, research\-driven prospecting by incorporating pharmacy\-specific insights, including public reviews and customer sentiment, into personalized outreach and precall strategies.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

1 or more years of tech sales experience
  
Experience in the tech/healthcare space
  
A passion for working directly with customers and making an impact
  
A positive attitude and an ability to work in a fast\-paced, constantly evolving environment
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  
  

This role offers a base salary plus uncapped commission.

Graduate Program Coordinator, Biosciences (5156C) \#88591 About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  

Departmental Overview
  
  

The Departments of Molecular and Cell Biology (MCB), Integrative Biology (IB), and Neuroscience (NEU) are among the largest academic departments at UC Berkeley. By several measures (including number of faculty and students, budget, and assigned square feet), these departments are larger than many UCB colleges and schools.
  
  

The three departments represent over 186 faculty FTE (including Adjuncts, Professors of the Graduate School, active emeriti, and 21 HHMI professors); 140 Researchers and Specialists; 185 post\-doctoral researchers; 350 graduate students; 2,100 undergraduate students; 60 department staff members; and a total state and extramural payroll of approximately 1,450 (including Graduate Student Instructors, Graduate Student Researchers, and research staff).
  
  

Financial resources include approximately $90M in annual extramural funding (which accounts for over half of the total sponsored research awards in the College of Letters \& Science) and over $91M other fund sources. Department personnel are currently housed in eight buildings located in three widely separated parts of the campus.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

The Graduate Program Coordinator provides a wide range of student services to the Graduate Affairs Office in support of the Integrative Biology and Molecular \& Cell Biology Ph.D. programs. This position leads projects while collaborating with and supporting team members, faculty, and students. The Graduate Program Coordinator manages large\-scale events and projects, including recruitment, commencement, and Graduate Student Instructor (GSI) hiring, as well as smaller\-scale events such as orientation and regular student programming. Additionally, this position provides administrative and operational support in areas such as communications, student advising, data collection and analysis, and student reimbursement processing.

The First Review Date for this job is September 14, 2026\. For full consideration, please apply by the first review date.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Event Planning (Recruitment, Orientation, Commencement) \- 45%

Plans, implements, and manages in\-person recruitment visits of prospective graduate students to MCB. Leads planning meetings with MCB GAO staff, Admissions Chairs, and student Recruitment Representatives.
  
Organizes two in\-person recruitment weekends for approximately 100\-130 individuals (applicants generally participate in 2 groups of 50\-65 individuals in January/February).
  
Acts as lead coordinator for the department, working closely with Biological Sciences Program Directors at other west coast universities regarding setting of dates, coordinating travel, and arrangements for travel between campuses as necessary.
  
Acts as lead department representative to applicants visiting the campus in all matters relating to travel, lodging, and faculty appointments. Coordinates with university travel agents on all travel arrangements for visiting applicants.
  
In collaboration with the student Recruitment Representatives, coordinates current graduate student participation in the recruitment process, including but not limited to housing visitors, contacting recruits, and organizing visit day activities such as panel discussions, poster sessions, seminars, and social activities.
  
Responsible for establishing contracts with local hotels for accommodation blocks. Plans and manages all group events, including seminars, panel discussions, catered meals, and faculty dinners. Negotiates any necessary service provider contracts. Provides on\-site management for all recruitment events. Maintains computer databases of all pertinent correspondence, schedules, and costs.
  
Compiles and rewrites, as necessary, all departmental information for visitors' packets.
  
Supports the department's extensive efforts to recruit students from historically underrepresented populations to the graduate program.
  
  

Commencement
  
  

Assists in other areas of the admissions process as needed, including the handling of \~800 applications received annually.

jobs.description:
**About Glide**
GLIDE is a nationally recognized center for social justice, dedicated to fighting systemic injustices, creating pathways out of poverty and crisis, and transforming lives. Through its integrated comprehensive services, advocacy initiatives, and inclusive community, GLIDE empowers individuals, families, and children to achieve stability and to thrive. GLIDE is on the forefront of addressing some of society’s most pressing issues, including poverty, housing and homelessness, and racial and social justice. GLIDE’s mission is to create a radically inclusive, just, and loving community mobilized to alleviate suffering and break the cycles of poverty and marginalization **Position Summary**:
GLIDE’s Women’s Center is seeking a compassionate and organized Program Coordinator to support the delivery of services for individuals who identify as women who are in immediate need of housing, essential needs (e.g., food, clothes, hygiene supplies) health and mental health services, navigation, and case management support, group support, etc. due to homelessness, gender\-based violence, and trauma. The Women’s Center will assess client’s needs, provide information and support to overcome barriers, provide early intervention, and case management. The Women’s Center Program Coordinator will assist the Senior Director to plan, coordinate, and implement the Center’s programs and services, provide direct services, and support other general operations of the program, such as facilitate/co\-facilitate groups and plan Center events. This individual will collaborate with the director, staff, and community partners to ensure compliance with multiple\-funding sources and their requirements.
### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Develop, coordinate, and maintain relationships and collaborations with GLIDE’s programs, established and new community partners to benefit participants and promote GLIDE’s Women’s Center.
* Be responsible for the coordination, creation, maintenance of service and/or staff schedules and business documentation (e.g. reports, flyers).
* Working in collaboration with case managers, develop and document Individualized Service Plans (ISPs) for clients, including data entry and reporting through CRM tools. Be responsible for organizing and managing Women’s Center events, which will involve coordinating all logistical aspects.
* Provide data coordination and quality assurance checks to ensure services meet predetermined standards and client satisfaction.
* Provide low\-threshold advocacy and case management, which includes referral, linkages, and assistance to health, health services, legal aid, and other human services and resources to support the client to reach their goals for improved safety, wellness, and quality of life.
* Conduct street and community outreach and attend community events to reach women and to promote the Women’s Center.
* Collaborate with Director to assign administrative tasks, referrals, cases, etc. to program staff. Ensure timely referral processing and allocation of new cases to other Women’s Center staff.
* Perform triage, intakes, needs assessments, service planning, service coordination, and follow up contacts in person, by email or phone with clients and other providers.
* Apply strength\-based services that are centered around motivational interviewing, cultural humility, and trauma\-informed care.
* Plan, organize, and oversee group sessions, activities, workshops, and individual support servies for clients Lead/co\-facilitate women educational and empowerment groups virtually and onsite.
* Maintain files and database records to track client progress. Prepare reports, success stories and challenges for internal review and reporting to external funders and stakeholders,; Ensure timely and accurate compliance with all reporting requirements.
* Adhere to professional boundaries and standards. Understand and follow basis ethics, values, and principles of regulatory practices. Adhere to all laws and requirements regarding HIPPA, confidentiality, child protective services, contractual agreements, etc.
* Meet professional obligations through efficient work habits such as collaborating with co\-workers, meeting deadlines, honoring schedules, attend and actively participating in staff and individual meeting, community meeting, supervision, case conferences, client conferences and in\-service trainings.
### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (e.g., psychology, social work, sociology, criminal justice) preferred; or at least four years of experience providing services (e.g., case management, or coordination of services) to women experiencing homelessness, domestic violence, gender\-based violence, and/or have been incarcerated.
* Demonstrated understanding of the psycho\-social and economic issues that impact women.
* Group facilitation experience helpful.
* Facilitates collaboration among Women’s Center staff and other GLIDE departments.
* Ability to develop processes and operations to support the implantation of new ideas and approaches.
* Knowledge of trauma informed approaches in supporting vulnerable women with a range of complex needs, particularly women of color experience houselessness, poverty, and other traumatic experiences.
* Has the ability to work effectively across cultures.
* Ability to plan, prioritize and organize tasks and meet deadlines, Strong attention to detail, particularly documentation of case files and updating database.
* Works well under pressure and manages stress effectively in a demanding and fast paced environment.
* Commitment to the mission, values, and philosophy of GLIDE.
### **Physical Requirements**


Reasonable accommodations can be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Ability to work on a computer and see details of objects at close range.
* Ability to hear within normal range, and communicate effectively (in person, telephone or Zoom).

**Executive Assistant to the CEO / Executive Operations Coordinator**
=====================================================================

**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Executive Assistant to the CEO / Executive Operations Coordinator provides high\-level administrative, organizational, and operational support to the CEO and Executive Team. This position helps keep executive priorities, meetings, projects, communications, and follow\-up activities organized and moving forward.


The role works closely with the CEO, Chief Clinical Officer (CCO), Vice President, Head of People, and Executive Clinical Team. The Executive Assistant serves as a central point of coordination across these leaders and helps ensure that information, decisions, assignments, and deadlines are communicated and followed through appropriately.


This is not a traditional administrative support position. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly with senior leadership, managing competing priorities, coordinating cross\-functional work, identifying issues before they become problems, and operating independently with limited day\-to\-day direction.


The position requires a high level of discretion because it involves access to confidential executive, employee, financial, clinical, legal, operational, and organizational information.

* Maintain professional working relationships with individuals at all levels of the organization.

jobs.title: Events & Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Build AI**
------------------


Build AI is the data hyperscaler for Physical AI. We're vertically integrated across hardware, manufacturing, logistics, collection, and model training to scale the physical labor dataset orders of magnitude faster than anyone in the world.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for our first Events \& Field Marketing Manager to build Build's events function from scratch.


You'll own how Build shows up in the world: the conferences we sponsor, the events we host around them, and the standalone experiences we create for customers, prospects, candidates, and the broader physical AI community.


This is a strategy **and** execution role. You'll decide where Build should invest, develop creative ways to stand out, and personally make the details happen. One week that might mean planning Build's presence at NeurIPS or CoRL; the next it could mean putting together an intimate dinner for AI researchers, a recruiting event in San Francisco, or an event format we haven't tried before.


You'll have significant autonomy, budget, and responsibility for representing Build externally.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build and own Build's events calendar and strategy from scratch.
* Own Build's presence at major AI and robotics conferences, including sponsorships, attendance, activations, and related events.
* Create and execute standalone events for customers, prospects, candidates, and the AI and robotics community \- including events ranging from executive dinners and small gatherings to recruiting events, conferences, launches, and larger experiences.
* Identify which conferences and events Build should invest in based on customer, recruiting, and brand impact.
* Develop creative concepts that make Build memorable and differentiated rather than simply showing up with a booth.
* Own events end\-to\-end: concept, venue, vendors, contracts, budgets, guest lists, invitations, logistics, onsite execution, and follow\-up.
* Measure what works and turn successful experiments into repeatable programs.
* Build the systems and operating processes required to scale the function as Build grows.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You**
--------------------------------

* Have **2\+ years of experience** in events, field marketing, experiential marketing, or a related role.
* Have personally owned conferences, sponsored events, dinners, or other in\-person experiences from concept through execution.
* Are exceptionally organized and detail oriented. You can run several complex projects simultaneously without dropping things.
* Have high agency. When something needs to happen, your instinct is to figure out how to make it happen rather than wait for instructions.
* Are creative and have strong taste. You care about creating experiences people actually remember.
* Are scrappy. You're equally comfortable negotiating a major sponsorship and fixing a last\-minute problem yourself five minutes before an event starts.
* Exercise excellent judgment and can represent Build confidently with customers, researchers, candidates, executives, and partners.
* Thrive in ambiguity and like building things from zero rather than inheriting established processes.
* Are willing to travel regularly for conferences and events.

**Even Better If**
------------------

* You've worked at a fast\-growing startup and know what it means to operate without much infrastructure.
* You have experience in AI, technology, robotics, or another technical industry.
* You've built an events or field marketing program rather than only executing an existing playbook.
* You've found unconventional ways to create memorable events without simply spending more money.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Build becomes one of the companies people consistently notice at the most important AI and robotics gatherings.


Our customers and prospects want to attend our events. Great candidates encounter Build through experiences that make them want to join. Our conference investments produce real relationships and opportunities. And behind the scenes, the entire program runs with exceptional operational discipline.


You turn events into a competitive advantage for Build to scale recruiting, brand, and customer acquisition.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive pay
* Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
* $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits
* Housing subsidy of $2k per month for those living within walking distance of the office
* Relocation support for those moving to San Francisco (Financial District) or Shenzhen (Nanshan)
* Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more
* Daily lunch and dinner in our office
* Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification
* Unlimited Codex and Claude credits
* Travel

**How we're different**
-----------------------


Build believes in the Bitter Lesson. By taking a general approach of learning from humans, our addressable market is all physical labor.


We are a fully in\-person team in San Francisco (Financial District) and Shenzhen (Nanshan), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.


Build AI is an equal opportunity employer. We review every application. If you do not meet every bullet, still apply. Questions: research@build.ai


Compensation Range: $130K \- $180K

We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to scale Decagon's paid social programs internationally, with an initial focus on EMEA. This role owns paid social spend end\-to\-end—LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, emerging platforms—and is responsible for standing up and scaling an EMEA motion. You'll partner closely with EMEA sales leadership to make sure spend allocation tracks where the deals actually are, not just where measurement is easiest.


This is a channel\-owner role for someone who's spiked in paid social specifically and has managed large budgets where efficiency and allocation decisions really matter. While paid social is the core of the role, you'll also flex into adjacent demand gen work—ABM, landing pages, email—as EMEA\-specific needs come up.

 **In this role, you will**

* Own paid social end\-to\-end: Run LinkedIn, Meta, X, and emerging platforms from creative brief through launch, optimization, and reporting. You're accountable for efficiency and output across the full paid social budget, not just execution.
* Scale spend into EMEA: Stand up and grow a paid social motion in EMEA from its current early stage. Adapt targeting, creative, and budget pacing to local buying behavior, currencies, and compliance requirements (GDPR and beyond).
* Align spend to sales opportunity: Partner with EMEA sales leadership to make sure budget allocation tracks where the actual pipeline opportunity is by market and segment, not just where measurement is easiest.
* Build the attribution story: Own how paid social spend connects to pipeline and revenue by market and channel. Bring your own point of view on what's working, backed by data, not just activity metrics like CTR and CPL.
* Test and systematize: Run structured experiments across creative, audiences, and channels, and turn what works into repeatable playbooks the rest of the team can use.
* Flex into adjacent demand gen: Support EMEA\-specific ABM, landing pages, and email work as needs come up, in partnership with the broader demand gen team.

 **Your background looks something like this**

* 5\+ years in performance marketing with a clear specialization in paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, TikTok, or similar) rather than search.
* Managed paid social budgets at meaningful scale (six\-figure\+ monthly spend) and can speak to how you allocated across campaigns, audiences, and markets.
* Have run or scaled paid social programs in EMEA specifically—different currencies, buying behaviors, compliance considerations (GDPR, etc.), and local nuances in creative and targeting.
* Analytical and comfortable owning your own attribution story: connecting spend by market/channel to pipeline and revenue, not just CTR and CPL.
* Used to working cross\-functionally with regional sales teams to align spend with where the pipeline opportunity actually is.
* Can flex beyond paid social into adjacent demand gen work (ABM, landing pages, email) when EMEA\-specific needs call for it.
* Thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment, where you're expected to take ownership, move quickly, and learn as you go.

 **Even better if you have**

* Have experience with Clay or similar audience\-building tools and are comfortable building and iterating on paid audiences
* Have stood up a paid social program in a new region from scratch (rather than inheriting one already built).
* Speak a European language relevant to key EMEA markets (UK, DACH, France, Benelux, Nordics).
* Bring point of view on emerging paid social channels or formats worth testing in EMEA.

 **Benefits**


We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
* Life Insurance and Disability Benefits
* Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)
* Parental Leave
* Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
* Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best
* Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

*These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.*


Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

------------



If you enjoy working outdoors in a professional and safe environment, consider a career with Bartlett Tree Experts! At Bartlett, we value a strong culture of excellence in safety, scientific research, lifelong learning, and career development.

Looking to start or grow your career in outside sales? Auto\-Chlor System is hiring motivated individuals who are ready to learn, build relationships, and earn an uncapped income.



Whether you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, banking, recruiting, athletics, or recently graduated, if you're competitive, coachable, and enjoy meeting new people, we'll teach you the rest.

* Motivated to build a rewarding sales career

Auto\-Chlor System is a national leader in commercial dishwashing, cleaning, sanitizing, and hygiene solutions with more than 140 branches across the United States. **Apply today and start your sales career with Auto\-Chlor System!**

In compliance with the California Fair Chance Act, we will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the law. Drug screening practices will comply with California law regarding off\-duty cannabis use."*

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative - Entry Level / Full Time
jobs.description:
Territory Sales Representative – Entry Level / Full Time
  
  

San Francisco CA
  
  

Break Into Pharmaceutical Sales with Pivya® at ImpactBio supporting Alembic Therapeutics
  
  

Do you have work experience that demonstrates drive, energy, and transferable skills that will lead to being a strong salesperson?
  
If you are looking to launch a career in pharmaceutical sales, this is your opportunity!
  
  

Alembic Therapeutics, in partnership with ImpactBio, is launching Pivya®, an FDA\-approved oral antibiotic for uncomplicated urinary tract infections (uUTIs). With over 40 years of success in Sweden, Pivya® is now entering the U.S. market—and we’re building a high\-performance sales team to support this launch.
  
  

As a Territory Sales Representative, you don’t need prior pharmaceutical sales experience—we’re looking for motivated, coachable individuals who are eager to learn, follow a proven sales model, and build a long\-term career in the industry. You’ll receive the training, tools, and mentorship needed to succeed while gaining real\-world experience calling on healthcare providers.
  
  

This full\-time role is with ImpactBio, a premier commercial partner in Life Sciences, with the potential to transition to Alembic Therapeutics based on strong performance.
  
View Openings \& Apply Here Job Openings \- ImpactBio
  
  

Why This Role Matters
  
  

This is more than a sales job—it’s a career entry point into pharmaceutical sales. You’ll be part of a national product launch, gaining experience in a highly competitive industry while developing the skills and discipline needed to grow your career.
  
  

**We’re looking for individuals who are:**  

* Hungry to succeed
* Open to coaching and feedback
* Willing to follow a structured plan
* Ready to put in the work to build something meaningful


If that sounds like you, we’ll teach you the rest.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Promote Pivya® to healthcare providers within your assigned territory
* Learn and execute a structured sales process and messaging strategy
* Build relationships with physicians, nurses, and office staff
* Consistently apply training and coaching in the field
* Develop and execute territory plans to achieve sales goals
* Provide timely updates, insights, and field feedback to leadership
* Maintain full compliance with all company and industry regulations


What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 1–3 years of experience meeting or exceeding goals/metrics (some sales experience would be helpful, B2B sales, Pharma sales, outside sales, customer facing)
* A strong desire to break into pharmaceutical or healthcare sales
* Proven work ethic and demonstrated a track record of going above and beyond to succeed
* Coachability—someone who takes direction well and applies feedback quickly
* High level of motivation, resilience, and accountability
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently while following a defined sales plan
* Willingness to travel extensively within territory
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record


Pharmaceutical experience is not required—drive, attitude, and willingness to learn are.
  
  

What We Offer
  
  

* Competitive base salary with a generous performance\-based incentive plan
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental \& Vision coverage
* Car allowance \& mileage reimbursement
* 401K plan with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Structured training program designed to help you break into and succeed in pharmaceutical sales
* Ongoing mentorship and field coaching
* A clear path for career growth and advancement
* The chance to be part of a major U.S. product launch


About Alembic Therapeutics
  
  

Alembic Therapeutics LLC, a U.S. subsidiary of Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., is committed to delivering high\-quality, patient\-focused branded pharmaceuticals. Our mission is to bring innovative, reliable medicines to the U.S. market while upholding the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and quality.
  
  

About ImpactBio
  
  

At ImpactBio, we build and launch commercial teams with a focus on performance, development, and long\-term success. We’re known for investing in our people and creating opportunities for driven individuals to grow into high\-performing professionals in the life sciences industry.
  
  

The annual base salary for this position is $65,000\. Compensation is aligned with the position’s scope and internal pay structure.
  
  

Apply Now
  
  

View Openings \& Apply Here Job Openings \- ImpactBio
  
  

ImpactBio is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)
  
  

We appreciate your interest in our company, however; only candidates meeting qualifications will be considered.

jobs.description:
**Clinic Operations Assistant (COA) \- Pleasanton**

  

**DESCRIPTION OF JOB RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES**

  

**Position Summary**



The Clinic Operations Assistant (COA) provides operational and administrative support to ensure the efficient daily functioning of the clinic. The COA serves as the primary administrative contact for clients, clinicians, and program staff and is responsible for coordinating front office operations, scheduling support, record management, and administrative processes that support clinical service delivery.



COAs work collaboratively with clinicians and supervisors to maintain organized clinic operations while ensuring a welcoming, professional, and efficient environment for clients and staff.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**


* At least three years of administrative support, front\-office, or office operations experience; healthcare, behavioral health, or medical\-office experience preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with scheduling, client reception, records management, data entry, and confidential information.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, scheduling systems, and electronic health record or insurance\-eligibility systems.
* Strong organizational, communication, customer\-service, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced clinic environment.
* Ability to maintain a regular, full\-time onsite Monday\-Friday schedule, with occasional evening work as needed.
* Ability to complete required background clearances, health screening, and TB testing, consistent with organizational policy.
  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Associate degree in business administration, healthcare administration, health information, or a related field.
* Experience in a behavioral health, healthcare, or medical\-office setting.
* Experience with insurance eligibility verification, authorizations, encounter reporting, or billing support.
* Experience using InSync or another electronic health record system.
* Valid California driver’s license and current auto insurance, if regular travel between sites is required.
  


**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1\. Client Scheduling and Appointment Coordination**



The COA supports clinicians by coordinating and managing appointment scheduling for outpatient services.



Responsibilities include:


* Scheduling client appointments in the clinic scheduling system based on clinician availability and treatment plans.
* Coordinating appointment times between clients and clinicians.
* Managing appointment changes, cancellations, and rescheduling requests.
* Monitoring clinician schedules for openings or conflicts.
* Communicating scheduling updates to clinicians and clients as needed.
* Maintaining accurate scheduling records through Insync database.
* Supporting client reminders and follow\-up communication when appropriate.


**Clinical decisions regarding treatment frequency, session length, and scheduling availability remain the responsibility of the clinician.**

  

**2\. Front Desk and Client Reception**


* Greet clients in a warm, professional manner upon arrival.
* COA electronically checks clients in and notify clinicians when their client has arrived.
* Provide general information regarding services offered by the clinic.
* Assist visitors and ensure visitor forms are completed.
* Maintain a welcoming, organized reception and waiting area.
  


**3\. Medical Records and Documentation Support**


* Organize and maintain client medical records according to agency policy.
* Prepare and process medical record requests.
* Ensure required forms and consents are completed and filed appropriately.
* Maintain filing systems for active and closed records.
* Assist with locating records when needed.
  


**4\. Data Entry, Reporting, and Administrative Support**


* Enter data into agency databases and state or county systems as required.
* Maintain referral logs and documentation.
* Assist with program reporting and administrative data tracking.
* Support clinicians, psychiatry, and supervisors with routine administrative tasks.
  


**5\. Billing and Insurance Support**


* Verify client insurance eligibility.
* Assist with service authorizations when required.
* Prepare encounter lists report.
  


**6\. Clinic Operations and Office Management**


* Ensure the clinic is opened and closed according to business hours.
* Maintain office organization, cleanliness, and supply levels.
* Order and store office supplies.
* Maintain shared spaces such as waiting rooms, kitchens, and meeting rooms.
* Support clinic activities, ex., birthday celebrations.
* Ensure office equipment is functioning and coordinate service requests when needed.
  


**7\. Communication and Team Support**


* Maintain communication between clinicians, clients, and administrative staff.
* Support coordination across clinic programs, ex., FSP, CIOS, and Med Management.
* Participate in staff meetings and organizational events.
* Provide coverage or administrative support at other clinic locations if needed.
  


**8\. Safety and Emergency Coordination**


* Serve as a point person for office emergencies (e.g., fire, earthquake, power outage).
* Maintain awareness of safety procedures.
* Ensure health and safety supplies are available to staff and clients.

  

  

**Personal Attributes:**


* Demonstrates Creativity, Flexibility and Openness
* Demonstrates High Professionalism
* Strong Organizational Skills
* Effective Interpersonal Skills, verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to Maintain Confidentiality
* Detail oriented.
* Works independently.
* Experienced in close collaboration with other administrative professionals
* Adept at working with both internal and external cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to work in fast\-paced and ever changing environments
* Ability to coordinate project details and project coordination skills
* Excellent conflict management resolution and problem\-s

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Ensures accurate execution of research protocols in accordance with Good Clinical Practices, HIPAA and required obligations to patient/subject, Principal Investigator, research team and sponsor. Interfaces directly with patients/subjects and Principal Investigators in support of the clinical trials if applicable. Works under general supervision.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Study Regulations – Aware of study regulatory status and keeps an up to date copy of regulatory documents. Assists with the informed consent process and ensure that the patient/subject fully understands what is required of them throughout the study. Follows through regularly with the patient/subjects and reminds them of visits and compliance.
* Clinical Competency: Position may require competency in performing EKG, phlebotomy technique, centrifuge, handling, storing and shipping of specimens. Clinical training and didactic competency tests may be required to perform basic procedures as part of position expectations. In house training and certification will be provided. Other trainings and competencies may be included as required.
* Continuous Learning: Position requires ongoing continuing education in all areas of research development. It is expected that the employee demonstrates proof of ongoing research education on a yearly basis. Training programs are provided through the SOM.
* Reporting and Analysis – Gathers and compiles data and assists in consolidating/analyzing data for presentation to sponsoring and regulatory agencies. Provides reports to all necessary parties (e.g., the principal investigator, sponsoring agency, etc.) on the progress of the study as needed. Conduct primary analysis to data collected. Formulates, prepares database and generates preliminary measurement reports for review by the PI.
* Grants – Assists in the preparation of grant applications and related activities such as developing grants proposals and fund raising activities. Collects and organizes required paperwork for submission if required. Follows up and coordinates resolution of all issues progress reports to the sponsors to fund medical research in the division.
* Budgets – May develop draft budgets and submit to the Principal Investigator. Assists in the preparation of funding reports to agencies. Helps to identify new potential sponsors/agents for trials and researches as assigned.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as required.
* Human Subjects’ Research – If applicable, updates and submits necessary documents required by the NYU Institutional Board (IRB), NYU Office of Clinical Trials and any other appropriate parties in order to obtain approval to conduct human subjects research. Secures accurate signatures and forwards documents and/or forms to appropriate destination. Might prepare and submit monthly enrollment statistics to the Office of Clinical Trials and provide other information in timely manner, as necessary.
* Research Activities – Collects patient information for the research project(s). This may include abstraction of data from the patient chart (e.g., laboratory or diagnostic test results, surgical/radiation treatments delivered, adverse drug reactions, etc); abstraction of data for publications, or data collection from outside physicians offices. Uses tools to facilitate data collection (e.g. calendars, schedules, tracking logs, etc). Audits and updates the database or the case report forms. Conducts study visits, obtains and documents information within the time frame specified. Research, collects, compiles and conducts preliminary analyses of data, statistics, and other materials for reports. Conduct preliminary analysis.
* Recruitment – Screens potential patients/subjects for eligibility to the study and schedules the initial visits. This may include researching and gathering information from the medical record, physician referral, advertisement and directly scheduling a visit to evaluate the patient/subject. Reviews all the elements of the screening process with the Principal Investigator that include but not limited to: inclusion/exclusion criteria, completed informed consent, documentation of the event and the patient/subject willingness to participate in the study.

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

To qualify you must have a Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, allied health or equivalent in a related discipline

jobs.description:
NYC \- 1211 Ave of the Americas


Full time


Job\_Req\_54977


**About the Role:**


We are seeking a Client Success Manager to own the post\-sale client journey for assigned new business accounts\- from signed deal through launch, activation, early adoption, and handoff into ongoing account management. This role serves as the primary relationship owner and cross\-functional coordinator during the early post\-sale phase, working closely with Sales, Regional Sales Coordinators, Operations, Adoption, Engagement, Customer Care, and Account Management.


The goal is a seamless transition from signed account to active, engaged client\- reducing friction, accelerating time to value, surfacing risk early, and bringing in the right specialist resources at the right time.


The Client Success Manager is the primary post\-sale relationship owner and "quarterback" across the early client lifecycle, accountable for client readiness, launch coordination, onboarding progress, standard\-account adoption execution, early engagement, and risk management. The role doesn't personally own every specialist workstream, but ensures each one happens successfully.


This is not a quota\-carrying role. Success is measured by how effectively clients launch, activate, adopt key products and workflows, engage early, and transition cleanly into ongoing account management.


**You Will:**


***Own the post\-sale relationship and launch orchestration***


* Serve as the primary point of contact from signed deal through onboarding and early adoption.
* Lead the handoff from Sales, ensuring client goals, use cases, stakeholders, and launch priorities are clearly understood and documented.
* Build 60–90 day onboarding milestones and success plans so clients know what success looks like and can achieve early wins.
* Maintain proactive, coordinated communication with clients and internal stakeholders to keep launches on track.

***Coordinate account setup with Regional Sales Coordinators and Operations***


* Partner with RSCs on order processing, account setup/changes, billing, CRM updates, and related handoffs.
* Partner with Operations and Fulfillment on provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, SLA readiness, and launch execution.
* Own coordination and follow\-through, while RSCs and Operations retain responsibility for their own administrative execution.

***Drive onboarding and adoption for standard accounts***


* Execute onboarding using established playbooks, milestones, and training guidance from the Adoption function.
* Ensure clients understand activation steps and build early usage habits.
* Loop in the Adoption Specialist for top\-tier, high\-risk, or complex accounts.

***Partner with the Adoption Specialist on strategy and high\-touch accounts***


* Work within playbooks and frameworks defined by the Adoption Specialist.
* Coordinate specialist involvement for strategic accounts, complex launches, low\-activation accounts, or accounts needing deeper admin enablement.
* Apply Adoption function learnings and best practices across the client base.

***Partner with Engagement and Lifecycle teams to deepen usage***


* Work with Engagement Strategy \& Performance and Customer Lifecycle Marketing to ensure clients get the right communications, campaigns, and enablement programs.
* Use engagement reporting and health signals to prioritize interventions.
* Connect clients to the right in\-life programs as they move from onboarding into sustained engagement.

***Monitor account health and manage risk***


* Track usage, activation milestones, and health signals to catch stalled onboarding, weak adoption, or early churn risk.
* Escalate early and coordinate support across Adoption, Engagement, Customer Care, Operations, and Account Management.
* Ensure critical issues stay owned and teams stay aligned on actions and timing.

***Act as the voice of the client internally***


* Share feedback, adoption insights, and emerging needs with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Care, and Client Success leadership.
* Partner with the Enterprise Customer Care \& Voice of Customer Lead on escalations and service themes.

***Support a clean handoff into ongoing account management***


* Ensure a clear transition from early post\-sale ownership into the ongoing account management motion once onboarding and early adoption are complete.
* Share account context, progress, risks, and adoption status with Account Managers so momentum carries through on high\-value accounts.

**Success Measures**


Measured on adoption, engagement, readiness, and handoff outcomes rather than direct revenue. KPIs may include:


* Account launch readiness and setup completion rate
* Time to onboarding completion and time to first value
* Activation and seat activation rate
* Adoption of priority products, workflows, and features
* Usage frequency, engagement depth, and health score movement
* Participation in training, webinars, and lifecycle programs
* Early identification and escalation of churn risk or stalled onboarding
* Quality of handoff into ongoing account management

**Cross\-Functional Partnerships**


* **Sales Account Executives** — post\-sale handoff and continuity from signed deal into launch
* **Regional Sales Coordinators** — order processing, account setup/changes, billing coordination
* **Operations and Fulfillment** — provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, launch execution
* **Adoption Specialists** — onboarding strategy, playbooks, training, high\-touch support
* **Engagement Strategy \& Performance / Customer Lifecycle Marketing** — health monitoring, engagement plays, in\-life programs
* **Enterprise Customer Care \& Voice of Customer** — escalations, white\-glove service, feedback loops
* **Account Managers** — transition planning and ongoing relationship continuity

**You Have:**


* 5 years of experience in client success, onboarding, implementation, account coordination, or related post\-sale roles in B2B, Saa

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Star Fire is a Long Island–based fire and life safety company and a proud member of the ONEAltus family of companies. As a Siemens distributor, we design, install, service, and inspect fire alarm and life safety systems for many of the region’s most demanding institutional clients — trusted by transit authorities, railroads, and school districts across Long Island to keep people safe and buildings code\-compliant. As we grow and transition long\-standing customer relationships to the next generation of leadership, we are seeking a driven, relationship\-focused Account Manager to steward and expand our most important accounts.  

  

The Account Manager is the trusted advisor and primary point of contact for Star Fire’s portfolio of strategic institutional accounts — including the MTA, the Long Island Railroad (LIRR), and school districts across Long Island. This role exists to take ownership of established, high\-value relationships historically managed by ownership and to protect, deepen, and grow them over time.  

  

This is fundamentally a relationship\-management role. You will retain and expand recurring inspection, testing, service, and project revenue across an assigned book of strategic accounts by being present, responsive, and genuinely useful to the people who depend on Star Fire for life\-safety compliance. You will coordinate Star Fire’s technical, project management, service, and office teams around each client’s needs — acting as the internal \\"quarterback\\" who ensures the customer experience is seamless.  

As a secondary focus, you will help develop new relationships with general and electrical contractors on Long Island — positioning Star Fire as their fire alarm and life safety subcontractor of choice on retrofit and new\-installation projects. This is an opportunistic growth lever, not the core of the role.  

  

Hourly Rate: $28\.00/hour \- $45\.00/hour**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**KEY ATTRIBUTES**
==================


The Account Manager is expected to embody the following key attributes:

* **Accountability** — take ownership of every strategic account relationship, from transition through long\-term growth and retention.
* **Client Focus** — prioritize long\-term institutional relationships, measured by satisfaction, retention, compliance, and account growth.
* **Collaboration** — win as a team across Star Fire’s technical experts, project management, service, scheduling, estimating, and office/accounting functions.
* **Trusted Presence** — become the reliable, credible face of Star Fire to institutional decision\-makers; earn the relationship equity that ownership built over decades.
* **Sense of Urgency** — respond promptly to client requests and drive timely coordination across the organization.
* **Time Management** — balance field time with institutional accounts against the office discipline needed to manage a clean, current book of business. Administrative work should never crowd out relationship\-building or customer engagement.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
========================

***Account Management (Primary Focus)***

* Serve as the single, consistent point of contact and trusted advisor for Star Fire’s strategic institutional accounts — MTA, LIRR, and Long Island school districts.
* Take ownership of relationships transitioning from ownership; introduce yourself, establish rapport, and set clear communication expectations with each key stakeholder during the transition period.
* Conduct proactive, in\-person outreach and site visits to review service satisfaction, surface concerns early, and build long\-term trust.
* Understand each account’s compliance calendar, inspection cycles, and code obligations; be the client’s guide to staying ahead of requirements rather than reacting to them.
* Educate clients on code and compliance requirements, using each conversation as an opportunity to add value and recommend appropriate services, upgrades, and repairs.
* Document all client interactions, commitments, and opportunities in the CRM for continuity, accountability, and a smooth long\-term transition of institutional knowledge.

***Account Retention \& Growth***

* Retain and grow recurring inspection, testing, and service revenue across the assigned portfolio of strategic accounts.
* Identify and pursue opportunities to expand within existing accounts — additional buildings, additional systems and service lines, deficiency repairs, and system upgrades or retrofits.
* Begin renewal planning well ahead of contract expiration; prepare by reviewing account history, outstanding deficiencies, management or leadership changes, and growth opportunities.
* Present the value of added services and compliance coverage proactively — reach out ahead of expirations, line up site visits for open deficiencies, and grow the account at renewal.
* **Public procurement awareness** — understand that many institutional accounts award work through competitive bids and public procurement; stay aware of bid calendars and coordinate with estimating and leadership so Star Fire is positioned to respond when opportunities come up.

***General Contractor Development (Secondary Focus)***

* Develop new relationships with general and electrical contractors on Long Island, positioning Star Fire as their fire alarm and life safety subcontractor of choice.
* Learn how each contractor bids, who makes decisions, and what they value most in a subcontractor — price, schedule, quality, or close\-outs — and set how quoting will work going forward.
* Expand relationships beyond a single contact — estimators, project managers, and owners — so Star Fire is known across the company, not dependent on one person.
* Coordinate with Star Fire’s project management and estimating teams to respond to bid and RFP requests for fire alarm and life safety installations, retrofits, and upgrades.

***Internal Coordination (Quarterback)***

**What is Bilt?**
Bilt is the membership for where you live.  

  

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.
Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.  

  

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.  

  

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.
**What’s the role?**
As a Technical Account Manager, you'll own the technical relationship for a portfolio of our enterprise and retail partners, making sure the product we build actually fits how they operate — both for their initial launch and for everything we build after. You'll be the connective tissue between what partners need and what our product and engineering teams ship, translating real\-world partner requirements into roadmap input while also owning the technical integration work that gets them live. While this person must have strong technical acumen and relationship management skills, they must also demonstrate a self\-starter attitude and creative problem\-solving. This is an exciting opportunity to join at the ground floor of a new product line at Bilt: a retail platform that orchestrates a seamless, personalized user experience across every merchant in the neighborhood. Experience in the payments space is strongly preferred. Experience supporting enterprise partners, along with retail \& POS integrations, is a plus.  

  

**In this role, you will…**
* Partner with product and engineering during pre\-launch to make sure new integrations and capabilities are scoped to fit the actual needs of enterprise and retail partners, not just the technical spec.
* Own the end\-to\-end launch process for your assigned partners, ensuring our API\-driven platform fits seamlessly into each partner's ecosystem from day one.
* Act as the voice of the partner internally, surfacing recurring needs, gaps, and feedback to product and engineering to influence what we build next.
* Be an expert on our integrations and capabilities, able to present these concepts concisely to client management, executive leadership, and the partner itself.
* Own and manage a book of assigned partners post\-launch, troubleshooting recurring technical issues, driving escalations to resolution, and documenting bugs with a focus on completion.
* Run technical calls spanning our retail partners, payment device team, and payment processors, aligning all parties on a single path to launch
* Serve as the technical escalation point for your portfolio, working in a rapid\-pace environment to analyze urgency and collaborate across internal teams.
* Collaborate with product and engineering on ticket documentation, test plans, end\-to\-end validation in test environments, and monitoring data after deployments.
* Identify new capabilities, technology partners, and integration opportunities that expand what we can offer partners.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing across teams by creating internal and external training material, such as configuration setup guides, FAQ documents, and flow diagrams.
* Have a base knowledge of SQL and Postman to quickly validate information and resolve integration issues.
  

  

**In terms of qualifications, we’re seeking:**
* 5\+ years in a technical account management, solutions engineering, implementation, or partner engineering role
* Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, and how to read/write API specifications
* Working knowledge of SQL and Postman to independently investigate and validate issues
* Experience in payments (processing, card networks, or payment operations) — strongly preferred
* Familiarity with loyalty/rewards programs and POS/retail hardware — a plus
* Track record of owning technical relationships with external partners, including scoping, launch, and post\-launch support
* Comfort operating across ambiguity — this is a new product line, and priorities will shift as we learn
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to flex between engineering\-level detail and executive\-level summary
* Experience troubleshooting production issues under time pressure, including coordinating across multiple internal and external teams

* **Compensation** \- We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program
* **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one** \- Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.

* **Commuter FSAs** \- We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive.

jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**



VML is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and award\-winning human\-first work for clients including AstraZeneca, Colgate\-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca\-Cola Company, and Wendy's. In 2026, VML was named *Campaign's* Global Network of the Year and ranked \#2 Creative Network of the Year at Cannes Lions. VML's global network spans 55\+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.



VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.



For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn \#WeAreVML.

**Who we are looking for:**



VML is seeking an Associate Account Manager to support the day\-to\-day activities and creative execution of integrated campaigns over a notable global consumer packaged goods brand. You will be a client liaison overseeing delivery of work for a global new product launch, ensuring client approvals are secured, client objectives are achieved, and timelines and budgets are met. You will play a role in communicating externally with the clients while supporting our internal teams to keep all apprised of project status, updates and changes.


**What you'll do:**


* **Client Support \|** Build rapport and credibility with client based on trust, sound counsel, responsiveness to client needs and flawless execution. Develop and update both client and project documents including: creative briefs, estimates, project timelines, media plans, status reports, conference reports and other supporting materials.
* **Team \|** Collaborate with creative, project management, production, and/or media teams to develop marketing programs and solutions for client. Keep agency team informed of client requests and changes, anticipate potential problems, and proactively develop solutions.
* **Process \|** Review all documents and creative work prior to submitting to client for review. Organize client presentations, meetings and conference calls, and prepare relevant documents, including agendas, meeting materials and conference reports. Capture and interpret program results, summarize findings, and work with senior team members to recommend program enhancements and/or changes to improve going forward


**What you'll need:**


* 0\-1 years of advertising agency experience or equivalent internship experience
* Knowledge and interest in CPG marketing and 360 integrated campaigns
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* An ability to build relationships and collaborate across teams, departments, vendors and clients to successfully accomplish work
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and professionalism
* Ability to effectively managing multiple projects, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously


**What we offer:**


* **Passionate, driven people** \| We champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work.
* **Consciously cultivated culture** \| We aim to embody the behaviors to build an inclusive community that is in it together, bringing both positivity and active listening into the workplace as we simultaneously strive to empower creative bravery.
* **Competitive benefits** \| What we offer full time hires ranges from the full spectrum of group health coverage options (medical, dental, vision) to a generous 401k match (100% dollar\-for\-dollar match, up to 5% of salary contribution), and a variety of paid time off offerings that reflect our investment in all aspects of your overall life balance and wellness.
* **Growth\-minded opportunities** \| We aim to nurture a culture of real\-time feedback, growth\-oriented mindset, and plenty of training opportunities through VML and WPP, so you can continue to grow personally and professionally.


We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.



WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Etsy Account Manager — Fine Jewelry (Full\-Time, On\-Site)

**About the role**

We're a fine jewelry company selling lab grown diamond engagement rings and jewelry online. We're looking for someone to manage and grow our Etsy shop. This is a hands\-on role for someone who already knows Shop Manager inside and out and wants full responsibility for a growing catalog.

**What you'll do**

* Create and maintain and update listings
* Keep pricing, variations, and inventory accurate across hundreds of listings
* Write and optimize titles, tags, and descriptions for Etsy search
* Respond to buyer messages and custom order inquiries within Etsy's response window
* Manage orders, shipping labels, tracking, and post\-sale follow\-up
* Run and monitor Etsy Ads, and report monthly on revenue, fees, ad spend, and conversion
* Handle returns, refunds, and cases while protecting shop metrics

**Requirements**

* 3\+ years managing an Etsy shop through Shop Manager, not just selling on Etsy
* Experience with listings that use multiple variation sets and large option matrices
* Working knowledge of Etsy SEO: titles, 13 tags, categories, attributes, and shop sections
* Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets, including bulk upload and edit files
* Strong written English for buyer messages and product descriptions
* Detail\-oriented with SKUs, pricing, and inventory data.
* Able to follow a set process exactly, including naming conventions, character limits, and draft\-before\-publish rules

**Preferred**

* Fine jewelry or diamond industry background, or familiarity with carat, center stone shapes, 14K, lab grown, halo, pavé, solitaire
* Experience running Etsy Ads and reading the stats and traffic dashboards
* Basic photo work: cropping, resizing, reordering images, white background cleanup
* Familiarity with Star Seller metrics and case handling

**To apply**

Send your resume and a link to at least one Etsy shop you've personally managed.

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

The White Cap family is committed to Building Trust on Every Job. We do this by being deeply knowledgeable, fully capable, and always dependable, and our associates are the driving force behind this commitment.


White Cap is hiring immediately for an **Account Manager!**


Do you want to help build America’s skyline and your own future? White Cap is North America’s leading distributor for professional contractors. We supply everything contractors need to build our nation’s remarkable construction projects, including stadiums, roads, bridges, highways, residential housing, and more. We are hiring immediately for an **Account Manager!**


*Why a* ***career*** *with White Cap?*


* **Comprehensive wellness and financial benefits:** White Cap offers excellent benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with company match, tuition reimbursement, and more! Out Account Managers have **unlimited earning potential!**
* **Relax and recharge:** We offer a generous time off package, including paid maternity and parental leave.
* **Stability:** Since 2020, White Cap has doubled in size and continues to grow.
* **Unlimited career potential:** White Cap is a stable and growing company offering unlimited career potential.
* **Love where you work:** White Cap has been certified as a *Great Place to Work* .
* **Inclusive culture:** Work in a place that values and celebrates who you are.

*An* ***Account Manager*** *at White Cap…*


* Builds relationships and develops plans to increase sales and profitability for mid\-size accounts.
* Generates viable sales leads and prospects through market and account research, sales events, networking, vendor events and computer programs. Contacts assigned and prospective accounts to secure new business.
* Develops and executes profitable business plans for managing accounts. Teams with individuals within sales and key corporate personnel to communicate account plans, pricing, and offer assistance to drive sales.
* Accountable for attaining assigned sales quota, part margin and controllable expense objectives.
* Interacts with customers, vendors, and associates to resolve customer and service related issues.
* Maintains a current and competent base of product knowledge and applies that knowledge when servicing customers.

* Generally has 2\-5 years of experience.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
* This position requires operation of a Company Vehicle or a Personal Vehicle and such operation is done consistently more than 20% of the average work week. If selected for this position, the company will run a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) report. A requirement of this position is an acceptable MVR report.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Prior experience in Outside Sales to professional contractors.
* Familiarity with Company products and services.
* Spanish language proficiency.

This role is eligible for additional variable compensation with a starting target of **$** **80** **,000** per year. We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We work with companies like PayPal, Rocket, H\&R Block, and many of the largest banks in the US to make it easy for consumers to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. As an Enterprise Account Management Lead, you’ll be responsible for managing the team of senior account managers who are growing the revenue from the Enterprise customer base, as well as setting the vision and strategy to build long\-term partnerships with our customers. You’ll collaborate cross\-functionally across our Product function and other Go\-To\-Market teams to help build solutions that drive team and customer success. As our business rapidly expands, we’re looking for an action\-oriented team leader who can also hire strategically \- bringing the right relationship managers into our business and enabling them to steward the next phase of Plaid’s growth and impact.


Ideal candidates will have experience in fintech working with enterprise clients, in mentoring and managing teams, setting and hitting revenue goals, building relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and analyzing customer trends to identify new growth opportunities. * Motivating and inspiring each team member to enable personal and professional career growth
* Working with leadership across the company to set direction for the Enterprise team, and Plaid as a whole

* 10\+ years of professional experience, 5\+ years managing a revenue\-driving team
* Proven track record of success driving revenue results at a technology company; strong preference towards those with prior experience in finances services or with banking and wealth management firms as clients
* Consultative sales approach with a product\-centric mindset
* Strong ability to articulate complex technical solutions and financial value prop \- internally for cross\-functional collaboration and externally to customers, including an executive audience
* Strong analytical skills to understand customer trends at scale
* Desire to get (more) technical and the ability to learn the ins and outs of Plaid's APIs
* Excitement for recruiting, onboarding, and coaching; a thoughtful approach to team planning and development
* Ability to create strategic relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Outstanding communication skills to drive internal alignment and results
