jobs.description:
**Job Title: Program Coordinator**
**Reports to:** Program Supervisor
Salary: $45,000 \- $50,000 (Compensation is commensurate based on experience, skills, education, and training).  

**Classification:** Full\-Time, **Exempt**  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM or 10:00 AM–7:00 PM (some flexibility required)
**Organizational Overview**
La Casa Norte serves youth and families confronting homelessness by providing access to stable housing and holistic, culturally responsive services. Our mission is rooted in compassion, dignity, and a commitment to equity. We embrace trauma\-informed, harm reduction, and client\-centered practices to empower individuals and transform communities.
**Position Summary**
The Program Coordinator is a cross\-functional leader who advances the integrity, effectiveness, and continuous improvement of case management services across all La Casa Norte programs. This role provides leadership, technical guidance, training, and strategic support to case managers and supervisors, while fostering consistent, high\-quality, client\-centered approaches across housing, shelter, and support services.
This position will offer enhanced support for complex, high\-intensity clients and provides coverage during staff absences or vacancies, or to launch new programs. In the absence of a Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator may also exercise designated authority to support team operations, reinforce accountability, and ensure continuity of service.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Direct Support and Temporary Caseloads**
* Provide direct client services on a temporary basis to maintain service continuity during staff transitions, support participants with significant barriers requiring advanced coordination, and/or temporarily manage a caseload in newly launched programs until permanent staff is onboarded.
* Provide intensive, client\-centered case management rooted in Harm Reduction and Trauma\-Informed Care.
* Ensure any direct service provided aligns with the organization’s commitment to client\-led, flexible, and holistic care.
* Provide support when the supervisor is unavailable for crisis situations, high\-need clients, and unexpected walk\-ins.


**Leadership and Practice Development**
* Provide expert guidance and coaching to case managers and supervisors across programs, strengthening clinical judgment, service planning, and engagement strategies.
* Promote fidelity to harm reduction, trauma\-informed care, and housing\-first approaches.
* Serve as a thought partner to program leadership, helping shape service delivery frameworks and quality standards.


**Professional Development and Training**
* Assist in designing and delivering onboarding, coaching, and ongoing training for case management staff across all levels.
* Support implementation of new tools, service models, or policy updates through structured staff development.
* Identify training needs and collaborate with HR and supervisors to create responsive learning plans.


**Supervision and Staff Management**
* Assist supervisor with daily operations of programs, including assigning caseloads, scheduling, and organization of program supplies.
* Provides real\-time direction, support and supervision to assigned case managers and program staff.
* Participates in hiring processes and makes candidate selection recommendations.
* Has the authority to issue verbal and written disciplinary actions, including corrective action plans.
* Assists with investigations into policy violations and recommends or initiates appropriate disciplinary responses in consultation with HR.
* Reviews staff performance provides coaching and support and contributes to annual performance evaluations.
* Approves time\-off requests and ensures adequate shift and program coverage.


**Strategic Projects and Stakeholder Engagement**
* Participate in or lead strategic initiatives that impact case management practice, such as process improvement pilots, interagency collaborations, or compliance redesign.
* Represent La Casa Norte in community forums or stakeholder meetings when assigned.
* Provide oversight or coordination of contracted services related to case management, when applicable.


**Quality Assurance and Compliance**
* Support the periodic review of case documentation, service plans, and outcomes data to ensure quality, consistency, and funder compliance.
* Assist in resolving systemic barriers to service delivery, supporting continuous improvement across teams.
* Promote equity in service access and delivery through culturally responsive case management practices.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, or a related field *or* at least four (4\) years of relevant case management experience.
* Minimum of one year of direct case management experience working with individuals and families who are homeless, at risk of homelessness, or otherwise marginalized.
* Previous supervisory experience.
* Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring, or training peers or interdisciplinary teams.
* Strong working knowledge of housing first, harm reduction, and trauma\-informed care principles.
* Reliable personal vehicle, proof of insurance, and a valid driver’s license.
* Ability to work flexibly across multiple programs and physical sites as needed.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills.


**Preferred:**
* **Bilingual in English and Spanish** (spoken and written).
* Experience in supportive housing, emergency shelter, youth services, or reentry work.
* Familiarity with CaseWorthy, HMIS, or other case management systems.

* **Holidays:** 10 paid holidays annually.
* **Sick Leave:** 6 sick days per year (up to 20 hours of unused sick time ma

jobs.description:
**Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?**


Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.


We are looking for a **Clinical Operations Coordinator** who will work with our internal lab, operations and customer success teams, as well as with equivalent teams at external reference labs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Autonomously own assigned workflows for order triage and order fulfillment
* Perform critical quality control functions in the order creation and reporting workflows
* Work with team leadership to implement workflow improvements across various systems to ensure company growth
* Autonomously own ad hoc processes and projects to ensure operational excellence is maintained
* Support ongoing and future projects within the team

**Qualifications**:

* 1\-3 years working experience
* 4 year college degree, preferably in Biological Sciences, Healthcare Administration, or a related field
* Is highly organized and systematic, with superb attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and complete tasks with a high degree of accuracy
* Persistent and resilient person who thrives in a fast\-paced, highly iterative environment
* Strong critical thinking, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills
* Impeccable written and verbal communication skills
* Show initiative and ability to work as part of a high\-level team while working independently

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with quality assurance and/or compliance in an FDA\-regulated industry is preferred
* Experience with Protected Health Information (PHI)


CHI: $50,000\-$55,000

  

The expected salary range may vary for other locations. Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position.


We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.


  
### **About Us**


Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics.


We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives.

We’re looking for people who can change the world.

  

Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.

------------------------

* Sales and business development
* Client relationships
* Performance marketing and customer acquisition
* Analytics and reporting
* Strategic partnerships
* Business operations
* New market and vertical expansion


You'll see how opportunities are identified, how client relationships are built, how deals are evaluated, and how data influences business decisions.


**Career Growth**
-----------------


This position is designed to be a **starting point, not a long\-term coordinator role**.


As you learn the business and demonstrate your strengths, the goal is for you to transition into a larger contributor position within LeadsIQ.

**Analytics \& Strategy** — analyzing performance, identifying trends, evaluating opportunities, and using data to help drive business decisions.

jobs.title: Client Experience Coordinator
jobs.description:
Let's be honest: families don't remember the name of a scheduling system. They remember the person who made their week easier.



At North Shore Pediatric Therapy, that person is the Family Child Advocate (FCA) — the calm in the chaos, the voice of reassurance, the behind\-the\-scenes orchestrator ensuring every child gets the care they deserve and every clinician walks into a day that runs smoothly.



Here, FCAs are trusted partners to families, real\-time problem solvers, and key players in providing the exceptional experience NSPT is known for. When a parent is overwhelmed, a child needs an urgent reschedule, or a clinic is juggling 30 moving pieces at once… **you're the one who turns stress into solutions.**



This is a **full\-time, in\-center position** with a **schedule of 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM,** with **one day each week requiring a 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM schedule.** You'll primarily work from our Deerfield, IL location. Approximately 50% of your time will be spent in the community building relationships. Compensation ranges from $21\-25 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.


**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------



Every hour of therapy counts — for a child learning to eat independently, say their sibling's name, or build the confidence they've never had before. You make those moments possible by keeping schedules full, communication clear, and families supported.



Across our centers, our therapists, Clinical Directors, and families will tell you the same thing: "I don't know what we'd do without our FCA."


**Who Thrives in This Role**
----------------------------


* A natural helper who finds joy in making someone's day smoother.
* A multitasker who can juggle 10 moving pieces without losing the warmth in their voice.
* A communicator who knows how to spin chaos into clarity.
* A schedules\-and\-systems thinker who loves finding the fastest path to a solution.
* A relationship\-builder who wants families to feel seen, supported, and appreciated.


If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!


**What** **You'll** **Do**
--------------------------


**Family Experience \& Operations**


* Be the go\-to support for families (schedule changes, questions, updates)
* Turn cancellations into makeups and keep schedules running smoothly
* Make real\-time adjustments as things shift
* Partner with Clinical Directors and therapists
* Keep the clinic organized, stocked, and running efficiently


**Marketing \& Growth (****50%)**


* Support local outreach efforts (schools, events, community partners)
* Help coordinate and host tours for prospective families
* Assist with center events and family engagement initiatives
* Drive online reputation (reviews, testimonials, family follow\-ups)
* Partner with leadership on simple, high\-impact marketing efforts
* Be the face of the center in the community

**Why** **You'll** **Love Working Here**
----------------------------------------



You're not just managing logistics — you're shaping a family's entire experience of therapy. You'll join a supportive team, build real relationships with families, and play a vital part in helping kids access the care they need.



If you're looking for a role where every day is meaningful and every detail matters, we'd love to talk.

This is a **full\-time, customer\-facing sales position** focused on connecting with homeowners, qualifying potential customers, and scheduling appointments for the TORQ sales team.

**The Schedule**

* Full\-time
* Tuesday–Saturday
* Two closing shifts per week
* Paid training
* Consistent weekly schedule

The ideal candidate is comfortable working a Tuesday–Saturday schedule and staying later for two designated closing shifts during the week.

**What You'll Do**

You'll be an important first point of contact between TORQ Coatings and potential customers.

**Daily responsibilities include:**

* Respond to inbound leads and customer inquiries.
* Make outbound calls to prospective customers.
* Speak with homeowners to understand their flooring needs and determine whether TORQ is a good fit.
* Educate prospective customers about TORQ Coatings' services.
* Qualify leads based on customer needs, project details, and other criteria.
* Schedule qualified appointments for the sales team.
* Follow up with leads who have not yet scheduled an appointment.
* Re\-engage previous leads and opportunities.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and appointments.
* Communicate important customer information to the sales team.
* Help maintain a consistent flow of qualified appointments.
* Provide a professional, friendly, and helpful customer experience.
* Work with the sales and leadership teams to improve lead conversion and appointment\-setting processes.

**We're Looking For People Who**

* Are confident and comfortable talking with customers.
* Have a positive and professional attitude.
* Communicate clearly and effectively.
* Are comfortable making outbound phone calls.
* Are organized and able to manage multiple conversations and follow\-ups.
* Are persistent without being pushy.
* Take ownership of their work.
* Are motivated by goals and results.
* Work well as part of a team.
* Are coachable and willing to learn.
* Show up on time and ready to work.
* Want an opportunity to grow within a company.

**Experience in these industries is helpful but not required:**

* Inside Sales
* Appointment Setting
* Customer Service
* Call Center
* Telemarketing
* Business Development
* Home Improvement
* Construction
* Flooring

Previous sales or appointment\-setting experience is a plus, but we're more interested in finding someone with the right attitude, communication skills, work ethic, and willingness to learn.

**Career Growth**

We're looking for people who want more than just a job.

As you develop your skills and demonstrate success, there may be opportunities to grow into roles such as:

* Sales Representative
* Outside Sales
* Senior Inside Sales
* Sales Leadership
* Business Development

**What Makes a Great Inside Sales Representative at TORQ?**

We're looking for someone who understands that great sales starts with great communication.

You'll be expected to:

* Listen before you sell.
* Treat every customer with respect.
* Follow up and follow through.
* Take ownership of your leads.
* Stay organized.
* Be persistent and solution\-oriented.
* Help the customer understand their options.
* Work as a team to create a great customer experience.

**Benefits**

* Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* 401(k)
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid Training
* Performance\-Based Opportunities
* Leadership and Growth Opportunities

**Why TORQ?**

At TORQ Coatings, we're building more than beautiful concrete floors — **we're building a company where great people can build lasting careers.**

Everything we do is guided by our **TOUGH** core values:

**T – Tenacity** — *Don't quit — solve problems.*

**O – Ownership** — *Own it — start to finish.*

**U – Unity** — *Win together — never alone.*

**G – Growth** — *Stay coachable and open to feedback.*

**H – Heart** — *Serve customers and team members with care and respect.*

If you're outgoing, driven, dependable, and enjoy talking with people, we'd love to meet you.

**Apply today and become part of the TORQ team.**

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

TORQ Coatings is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status under applicable law.

**The Strategic Account Marketing team builds a custom (1:1\) marketing strategy for top clients that aligns with enterprise product\-related account goals. We think holistically about each book of business in terms of the known and prospective executives, buyers, and users that need to be influenced to grow wallet share.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Who We Are**
--------------

**Here are the things that make this team unique:**
**We are agile:**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* **We are tied directly to the pace of the business (fast!) and need to be comfortable moving quickly. It may be scary at first, but we have a ton of templates, strategies, and learnings from the past 2 years that we can use together to speed time to market.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**We are client obsessed:**
---------------------------

* **We get to know each book of business that we cover (deeply). We study account plans, earnings reports and anything else that we can get our hands on, sharing relevant information proactively with the account teams that we work with, and developing strategies centralized on these learnings.**

* **This is a unique role that requires additional care and understanding, as we’re constantly describing marketing efforts to sellers, so we communicate thoughtfully and patiently. Applicants in the County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* High School Diploma, GED equivalent, or practical experience.
* Not currently enrolled in or completed a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in a digital marketing\-related field.
* Less than 1 year of relevant digital marketing experience.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience using Google Workspace or a similar suite of productivity tools.
* Ability to work independently and within a team framework.
* Ability to navigate multiple ambiguous tasks and competing priorities while finding suitable solutions and seeking help/advice where appropriate.
* Ability to be proactive and have a positive attitude.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and problem solving skills, customer service capabilities, and critical thinking abilities.
* Enthusiasm and passion for new technologies, demonstrated through personal projects and commitment to learning new skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Digital Marketing Apprenticeship is a Department of Labor Registered Apprenticeship Program and a structured learning and development opportunity. During the 18 month program, apprentices will participate in on\-the\-job training, related technical instruction, and career development workshops to develop professional and durable skills. Upon completion, apprentices receive a nationally\-recognized credential, certified by the U.S. Department of Labor.


As a Digital Marketing Apprentice at Google, you will develop the skills you need to pursue an entry\-level career in digital marketing.


You will help define, design, and execute digital marketing campaigns across channels for brands across the world. You will develop the skills to create strategy, content, and optimization, using AI tools where applicable to enhance creativity and efficiency. You will analyze market/campaign data, track key metrics, and present findings to drive objectives. You will engage clients, and gain exposure to consumer and business Google products.


Apprentices are paid hourly for their time split between on\-the\-job training and related technical instruction, and are required to dedicate 40 hours each week to the program. Apprenticeships begin with an immersive virtual onboarding experience to build a foundational understanding of the profession. Apprentices will then join a Google team to train on\-the\-job, while continuing to engage in track\-specific learnings and career workshops throughout the program. As part of the program, apprentices receive holistic career readiness support, and towards the end of the program will have the time and space to prepare for their next endeavor.  

  

Find more details about apprenticeships and a list of FAQs on goo.gle/apprenticeships.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support digital strategy design and implementation, including go\-to\-market and multi\-channel campaigns.
* Optimize campaigns and digital assets for SEO, leveraging AI\-powered tools when applicable.
* Manage Search, Video, and Programmatic campaigns, track key metrics, and present comprehensive findings to clients and cross\-functional teams.
* Practice responsible, effective, and innovative use of AI.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: VA Regional Sales Representative
jobs.description:
American Armor Gloves is hiring its first VA Regional Sales Representatives to build out a dedicated sales function for VA healthcare accounts. This is a new sales team, not a new company — AAG has spent years developing the manufacturing capacity, quality systems, and early government relationships this role is built to take advantage of.


**The Opportunity**
===================



This is a new role, but it isn't a cold start. AAG has already done much of the groundwork required to sell into government and VA healthcare: compliant manufacturing, a quality system built for regulated buyers, and early relationships with VA stakeholders. What hasn't existed until now is a dedicated sales representative to develop that opportunity fully within an assigned VA region. You'll be one of the first five or six people to hold this role, working from an established foundation rather than starting from nothing.


**What You'll Own**
===================


* Sales development and account management for VA facilities, CBOCs, and healthcare systems within your assigned region.
* Relationships with the people who make purchasing decisions — Chiefs of Logistics, procurement leads, and clinical stakeholders.
* A territory pipeline you build and manage yourself, from first contact through closed business, navigating VA purchasing processes along the way.
* Ongoing account growth, including new facility penetration and deeper relationships within your region.

**What Makes You the Right Fit**
================================


* **Government or VA sales experience — required.** You should already understand how these purchasing processes work.
* **Existing relationships within VA healthcare systems — preferred.** It's a specific, relationship\-driven network, and prior experience in it shortens the learning curve.
* **Comfort managing a defined territory independently,** with real ownership over how you prioritize and run it.
* **Strong follow\-through and CRM discipline,** since accurate pipeline and forecast tracking is a core part of the role, not an afterthought.

**Compensation \& Growth**
==========================



Base salary plus commission, structured to be competitive with current market data for government and federal healthcare sales roles, with uncapped upside as your territory develops. As AAG's government sales team grows, there is a defined path forward — into senior territory roles, national account management, and eventually broader federal healthcare opportunities beyond the VA.


**About American Armor Gloves**
===============================



American Armor Gloves manufactures high\-quality nitrile gloves, produced in West Columbia, South Carolina. The company has built its business on advanced manufacturing, operational discipline, and a commitment to quality — supplying healthcare professionals, first responders, and other essential workers who depend on consistent, reliable protection.


**We are actively interviewing for this role now — apply today to be considered.**

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative- Advertising Executive (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Compensation:** Draw \+ Lucrative Commission \+ Performance Incentives

 **The Opportunity**


Are you a self\-motivated "hunter" who thrives on variety? Guide Book Publishing, an industry leader since 1991, is looking for a strategic Advertising Account Executive. Unlike traditional sales roles where you call the same list for years, our team moves to a **new assignment every 2\-3 weeks**, helping local businesses across 24 states reach "micro\-communities" through high\-quality direct\-mail advertising.

 **How it Works**

* **The Workflow:** You’ll switch assignments frequently, focusing on businesses within a 3\-5 mile radius of a specific congregation or community center.
* **The Method:** 70% of your time is spent on high\-energy outreach (phone, email, and video meetings); 20% on market research; and 10% on contract execution.
* **The Flexibility:** This is a remote role, but does require getting your materials back to the Post Office to return to the Home Office.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **New Business Development:** Identify and close new advertising partnerships to meet production goals.
* **Consultative Sales:** Educate local business owners on the ROI of being featured in our community guides and directories.
* **Relationship Management:** Act as the primary liaison between your clients and our operations staff to ensure an excellent experience.
* **Account Growth:** Nurture and maintain large\-scale accounts within your metro area.
* **Administrative Precision:** Manage contracts and paperwork accurately and return assignment materials via USPS upon completion.

 **Compensation \& Benefits**


We offer a structure that rewards high performers and provides security through a comprehensive benefits package via ADP TotalSource.

* **Draw \& Commission:** Payroll is based on "Cash In" from sales, with a Draw program available to stabilize income as you build your funnel.
* **Performance Bonuses:** Additional incentive pay for hitting Assignment, Monthly, Quarterly, and Annual targets.
* **Benefits:**
	+ Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
	+ 401(k) with Company Match
	+ Life Insurance
	+ Paid Time Off (PTO)

 **Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 1\-2 years of sales experience preferred (or equivalent education).
* **Mindset:** A self\-starter who can manage their own schedule without being micromanaged.
* **Skills:** Proficient in Excel, scanning, email, and PDF management. Strong ability to calculate discounts and commissions accurately.
* **Communication:** Persuasive verbal skills and clear, professional written communication.
* **Requirements:** Valid Driver’s License and Auto Insurance.

 **Why Guide Book Publishing?**


We serve the communication needs of over 800 micro\-communities. If you are looking for a role that balances the freedom of remote work with the fast\-paced nature of community\-based sales, we want to talk to you.

 **Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

* Requires Valid Driver’s License and Auto Insurance
* Frequently required to sit and utilize a keyboard and phone.
  

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About CodeHS**
----------------


CodeHS is a comprehensive platform helping K\-12 schools teach computer science. We provide curriculum, professional development, and a full software platform. CodeHS is used by millions of students and thousands of schools and districts around the US and the world.

**Mission**
-----------

**The mission of CodeHS is to empower all students to meaningfully impact the future.** We believe that in the 21st century, coding is a foundational skill, just like reading and writing. That’s why we say: **Read, Write, Code.** Coding and computer science are essential skills for students to learn and schools to teach.

  

CodeHS is looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to generate new sales leads by prospecting potential district customers and conducting outbound outreach via email and phone to connect with district administrators. Your primary focus will be setting up appointments with district administrators for our Account Executives.

**Job Description**
-------------------

 **Responsibilities**

* Generate leads for the Account Executive team by reaching out to stakeholders over multiple channels (phone, email, LinkedIn, etc).
* Call Curriculum and CTE administrators from school districts in a set territory and schedule meetings for AEs to pitch CodeHS
* Create and send email sequences to district and school administrators to schedule discovery calls and educate stakeholders about CodeHS Pro
* Call active free teachers to learn more about what their district is doing for CS and try to get names/introductions to district administration
* Cultivate interest in upgrading among teachers using our free version
* Create and send outbound email campaigns to district administrators (Directors, Superintendents) with the goal of scheduling a meeting for Account Executives
* Contact teachers/administrators from recently won deals to ask if they can recommend other stakeholders to contact at neighboring schools/districts that could use CodeHS

**Requirements**

* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree
* 1\-2 years sales or related experience with an interest in growing your career in sales
* Highly organized and efficient
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Able to work independently in a fast paced environment
* No experience coding is required, but you should have an interest in learning

**Preferred**

* Previous experience as a B2B software sales SDR
* Experience working with Salesforce and sales engagement platforms like MixMax or Outreach

 **This is an in\-office position, which would require 5 days a week in the CodeHS Chicago office at 747 N LaSalle in River North.**


Must be authorized to work in the US.

 **Compensation**

* Base Salary: $57,000
* Incentive Compensation: $18,000
* On Track Earnings: $75,000


Incentive compensation is based on the number of attended meetings.

 **Benefits:**

* Health, dental, vision
* Equity
* 401k plan with 4% match
* Paid Parental leave
* Strong vacation policy (22 days off \+ 16 company holidays)
* Short term and long term disability
* $400 annual professional development stipend

**Company Values**
------------------

### **Encourage Teaching and Learning**


CodeHS is about providing excellent teaching and learning opportunities in computer science for students all over the world. We value creating fun, accessible and creative learning experiences for teachers, for students, and for team members at CodeHS. We believe that education\-and specifically coding\-within the formal K\-12 system, the higher\-education system, and beyond has the power to allow everyone to unlock their full potential.

### **Create a Direct Positive Impact**


At CodeHS we value creating a direct positive social impact with our work. We work directly with students, teachers, schools and districts to implement computer science classes. Through building great curriculum, tools and resources to allow high schools to teach computer science, we can create a direct educational benefit to students to help explore the limitless world of computing. We believe that expanding access to computer science education will empower students to take an active role in creating the future.

### **Make It Fun and Creative**


Bringing fun and creativity to every aspect of our work is a main focus for us at CodeHS. It starts with a fun, friendly and accessible curriculum, that allows students the opportunity to build creatively and engage in thoughtful problem solving. We also focus on developing a creative and fun environment to work in, and think that this allows us to bring novel approaches to challenging problems. Computing is about logic\-but it’s also about creativity\-and we hope to share that excitement with teachers and students through CodeHS.

**Our Operating Practices**

**Get the job done**


We figure out the real problem to be solved and take ownership over seeing it to completion. We help move things across the finish line.

**Bring context and big picture awareness**


We consider the projects we work on in their context and see how our projects impact the team, company, and the customer.

**Adaptable**


We adapt to changing needs across customers and the team, and make good plans but know that they can change as we get new information.

**Growth Mindset**


We're always looking to learn and improve, and we share that mindset with teachers and students. We’re working to improve individually and as a team.

**Team player**


We help out our teammates and we’re team players. We make decisions with a team first approach and strive to act in the best interest of the company as a whole.

**Constructive and solution oriented**


When approached with problems and roadblocks, we're constructive and solution oriented. We think through problems and tradeoffs, proactively finding solutions.

**Good vibes**


We bring positive energy whether in person or virtually to help contribute to making a positive work environment for everyone.

jobs.title: Consultative Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Help customers choose the right HVAC system with confidence****No HVAC experience is required—we provide comprehensive product and system\-design training.**


Alpine Home Air Products is looking for a curious, technically inclined sales professional who can help homeowners make confident decisions about heating and cooling systems.


This is a consultative inside\-sales role. You’ll speak with homeowners and contractors, understand their projects, build system recommendations using our proprietary tools, explain the available options, and guide customers toward a purchase that fits their home, priorities, and budget.


You do not need to arrive as an HVAC expert. You do need to be comfortable learning technical products, asking thoughtful questions, making recommendations, and helping customers move from uncertainty to a clear decision.

**What You Will Do*** Speak with homeowners and contractors by phone or video
* Ask questions about the property, project, comfort needs, and budget
* Use our design software to develop appropriate system recommendations
* Explain technical concepts in clear, everyday language
* Help customers compare cost, comfort, efficiency, aesthetics, installation complexity, and long\-term value
* Recommend a direction based on the customer’s priorities
* Address questions and concerns that may prevent the customer from moving forward
* Follow up with customers and guide qualified opportunities toward purchase
* Prepare accurate design summaries so orders can be finalized correctly
* Balance sales results with design quality and the long\-term customer experience

**You Might Be a Strong Fit If You*** Have experience in consultative sales, inside sales, customer success, project consulting, or another customer\-facing role
* Are comfortable guiding a conversation and asking for a decision
* Enjoy learning how products and systems work
* Can simplify technical information without oversimplifying it
* Listen carefully and make thoughtful recommendations
* Stay organized when several options or project details are involved
* Take ownership of follow\-up and results
* Are comfortable using software and learning new tools
* Care about selling the right solution—not simply any solution


Experience with HVAC, home improvement, appliances, construction products, building materials, technical products, or other high\-consideration purchases is helpful but not required.

**About Alpine**


Alpine Home Air Products has helped customers purchase heating and cooling equipment online for more than 20 years. Through our Blueridge brand, we offer one of the broadest mini\-split product lines in the market.


Because HVAC purchases are expensive and unfamiliar to many homeowners, customers need more than a list of products. They need someone who can understand their project, clarify their options, and confidently recommend the right approach. That is the purpose of this position.

 **Benefits**  

* Base salary: $75,000
* Performance bonus based on customer outcomes, design quality, and team success
* Group health insurance plus health savings account, 401k, paid time off, paid holidays, life insurance, short\-term disability and more
* Ongoing training and professional development
* Work\-from\-home (remote) or hybrid Chicago\-based
* All computer equipment and training will be provided

*Learn more and view all openings at:* *careers.alpinehomeair.com*

Acting as the primary commercial owner of the channel, you will build and strengthen relationships with official dealers, strategic partners and key accounts while identifying new opportunities to accelerate growth.

**Market Presence \& Relationship Building**
--------------------------------------------

* Develop a strong network within the Print\-on\-Demand, decoration and apparel ecosystem
* Establish trusted relationships with key stakeholders across customers, partners and industry influencers
* Represent Stanley/Stella at trade shows, industry events, customer meetings and networking opportunities

**Sales Planning, CRM \& Business Performance**
-----------------------------------------------

* Maintain accurate customer, opportunity and account information within the CRM environment
* Deliver reliable sales forecasts and provide clear insights on performance drivers, risks and opportunities
* Leverage sales data, market intelligence and business insights to prioritize opportunities and optimize account performance
* Develop and monitor annual sales plans for the channel, strategic accounts and dealer network
**Cross\-Functional Execution**
-------------------------------

* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Planning, Finance and Customer Excellence teams to deliver outstanding customer experiences
* Ensure commercial commitments are aligned with inventory availability, operational capabilities and profitability objectives
* Support the development of customer\-facing initiatives, co\-branded programs and growth opportunities that strengthen demand and engagement
#### **About you**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in Sales, Business Development or Key Account Management within Print\-on\-Demand, promotional products, wholesale apparel or a related industry
* Proven track record of developing strategic partnerships, recruiting channel partners and growing key accounts

Founded in 2012, Stanley/Stella has become Europe’s leading brand for premium and sustainable blank apparel. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to redefine how responsible fashion is made, distributed and experienced.

Join a company that leads by example, grows with purpose and creates change that lasts.

**About the Role:**


We are seeking a Client Success Manager to own the post\-sale client journey for assigned new business accounts\- from signed deal through launch, activation, early adoption, and handoff into ongoing account management. This role serves as the primary relationship owner and cross\-functional coordinator during the early post\-sale phase, working closely with Sales, Regional Sales Coordinators, Operations, Adoption, Engagement, Customer Care, and Account Management.


The goal is a seamless transition from signed account to active, engaged client\- reducing friction, accelerating time to value, surfacing risk early, and bringing in the right specialist resources at the right time.


The Client Success Manager is the primary post\-sale relationship owner and "quarterback" across the early client lifecycle, accountable for client readiness, launch coordination, onboarding progress, standard\-account adoption execution, early engagement, and risk management. The role doesn't personally own every specialist workstream, but ensures each one happens successfully.


This is not a quota\-carrying role. Success is measured by how effectively clients launch, activate, adopt key products and workflows, engage early, and transition cleanly into ongoing account management.


**You Will:**


***Own the post\-sale relationship and launch orchestration***


* Serve as the primary point of contact from signed deal through onboarding and early adoption.
* Lead the handoff from Sales, ensuring client goals, use cases, stakeholders, and launch priorities are clearly understood and documented.
* Build 60–90 day onboarding milestones and success plans so clients know what success looks like and can achieve early wins.
* Maintain proactive, coordinated communication with clients and internal stakeholders to keep launches on track.

***Coordinate account setup with Regional Sales Coordinators and Operations***


* Partner with RSCs on order processing, account setup/changes, billing, CRM updates, and related handoffs.
* Partner with Operations and Fulfillment on provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, SLA readiness, and launch execution.
* Own coordination and follow\-through, while RSCs and Operations retain responsibility for their own administrative execution.

***Drive onboarding and adoption for standard accounts***


* Execute onboarding using established playbooks, milestones, and training guidance from the Adoption function.
* Ensure clients understand activation steps and build early usage habits.
* Loop in the Adoption Specialist for top\-tier, high\-risk, or complex accounts.

***Partner with the Adoption Specialist on strategy and high\-touch accounts***


* Work within playbooks and frameworks defined by the Adoption Specialist.
* Coordinate specialist involvement for strategic accounts, complex launches, low\-activation accounts, or accounts needing deeper admin enablement.
* Apply Adoption function learnings and best practices across the client base.

***Partner with Engagement and Lifecycle teams to deepen usage***


* Work with Engagement Strategy \& Performance and Customer Lifecycle Marketing to ensure clients get the right communications, campaigns, and enablement programs.
* Use engagement reporting and health signals to prioritize interventions.
* Connect clients to the right in\-life programs as they move from onboarding into sustained engagement.

***Monitor account health and manage risk***


* Track usage, activation milestones, and health signals to catch stalled onboarding, weak adoption, or early churn risk.
* Escalate early and coordinate support across Adoption, Engagement, Customer Care, Operations, and Account Management.
* Ensure critical issues stay owned and teams stay aligned on actions and timing.

***Act as the voice of the client internally***


* Share feedback, adoption insights, and emerging needs with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Care, and Client Success leadership.
* Partner with the Enterprise Customer Care \& Voice of Customer Lead on escalations and service themes.

***Support a clean handoff into ongoing account management***


* Ensure a clear transition from early post\-sale ownership into the ongoing account management motion once onboarding and early adoption are complete.
* Share account context, progress, risks, and adoption status with Account Managers so momentum carries through on high\-value accounts.

**Success Measures**


Measured on adoption, engagement, readiness, and handoff outcomes rather than direct revenue. KPIs may include:


* Account launch readiness and setup completion rate
* Time to onboarding completion and time to first value
* Activation and seat activation rate
* Adoption of priority products, workflows, and features
* Usage frequency, engagement depth, and health score movement
* Participation in training, webinars, and lifecycle programs
* Early identification and escalation of churn risk or stalled onboarding
* Quality of handoff into ongoing account management

**Cross\-Functional Partnerships**


* **Sales Account Executives** — post\-sale handoff and continuity from signed deal into launch
* **Regional Sales Coordinators** — order processing, account setup/changes, billing coordination
* **Operations and Fulfillment** — provisioning, entitlements, technical readiness, launch execution
* **Adoption Specialists** — onboarding strategy, playbooks, training, high\-touch support
* **Engagement Strategy \& Performance / Customer Lifecycle Marketing** — health monitoring, engagement plays, in\-life programs
* **Enterprise Customer Care \& Voice of Customer** — escalations, white\-glove service, feedback loops
* **Account Managers** — transition planning and ongoing relationship continuity

**You Have:**


* 5 years of experience in client success, onboarding, implementation, account coordination, or related post\-sale roles in B2B, Saa

**Job Description**
-------------------


Star Fire is a Long Island–based fire and life safety company and a proud member of the ONEAltus family of companies. As a Siemens distributor, we design, install, service, and inspect fire alarm and life safety systems for many of the region’s most demanding institutional clients — trusted by transit authorities, railroads, and school districts across Long Island to keep people safe and buildings code\-compliant. As we grow and transition long\-standing customer relationships to the next generation of leadership, we are seeking a driven, relationship\-focused Account Manager to steward and expand our most important accounts.  

  

The Account Manager is the trusted advisor and primary point of contact for Star Fire’s portfolio of strategic institutional accounts — including the MTA, the Long Island Railroad (LIRR), and school districts across Long Island. This role exists to take ownership of established, high\-value relationships historically managed by ownership and to protect, deepen, and grow them over time.  

  

This is fundamentally a relationship\-management role. You will retain and expand recurring inspection, testing, service, and project revenue across an assigned book of strategic accounts by being present, responsive, and genuinely useful to the people who depend on Star Fire for life\-safety compliance. You will coordinate Star Fire’s technical, project management, service, and office teams around each client’s needs — acting as the internal \\"quarterback\\" who ensures the customer experience is seamless.  

As a secondary focus, you will help develop new relationships with general and electrical contractors on Long Island — positioning Star Fire as their fire alarm and life safety subcontractor of choice on retrofit and new\-installation projects. * Serve as the single, consistent point of contact and trusted advisor for Star Fire’s strategic institutional accounts — MTA, LIRR, and Long Island school districts.

We’re scaling rapidly, with 2,000\+ colleagues across multiple markets, and we’re just getting started!

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you will play a critical role in generating new business opportunities by booking qualified meetings for our Field Sales Representatives.

As a BDR, your responsibility is to:

**Overview**

**Security Operations Coordinator / Corporate Security Officer**

**Position Summary**

The Security Operations Coordinator is responsible for overseeing and monitoring security operations for company\-owned restaurants, catering production facilities, and corporate locations. This position serves as the central point of coordination for all security\-related matters, ensuring the safety of employees, guests, company assets, and facilities. The role includes monitoring access control systems, surveillance cameras, incident reporting, loss prevention initiatives, emergency response coordination, and compliance with company security policies and procedures.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Monitor security operations for restaurants, catering production facilities, and corporate offices.
* Oversee video surveillance systems and investigate suspicious activities or security concerns.
* Monitor facility access control systems and ensure authorized access to company locations.
* Conduct periodic security reviews and identify vulnerabilities or areas for improvement.
* Coordinate responses to alarms, emergencies, and security\-related incidents.

**Incident Management**

* Receive, document, investigate, and report security incidents.
* Maintain detailed records of incidents, investigations, and corrective actions.
* Coordinate and prepare reports and audits, communicate findings to leadership.

**Loss Prevention**

* Support company initiatives to reduce theft, fraud, vandalism, and inventory shrinkage.
* Monitor potential loss prevention concerns and recommend corrective measures.
* Investigate suspected theft, policy violations, and security breaches.
* Assist management with security investigations and documentation.

**Compliance \& Policy Enforcement**

* Ensure compliance with company security standards, food production facility requirements, and safety protocols.
* Support implementation and enforcement of security policies and procedures.
* Assist with security training and awareness programs for employees and managers.

**Emergency Preparedness**

* Support emergency response planning and business continuity efforts.
* Assist in developing evacuation procedures and emergency communication plans.
* Participate in emergency drills and incident response exercises.
* Serve as a resource during security and safety\-related emergencies.

**Communication \& Coordination**

* Serve as the primary contact for security\-related matters across all company locations.
* Coordinate security communications between restaurants, catering facilities, and corporate leadership.

**Education**

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Security Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred not necessary.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 2 years of security, law enforcement, loss prevention, risk management, or related experience preferred.
* Experience monitoring multiple sites or facilities is highly preferred.
* Experience conducting investigations and preparing incident reports.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Knowledge of security systems, surveillance equipment, and access control technologies.
* Strong investigative, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and security monitoring software.
* Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions during emergencies.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to sit for extended periods while monitoring security systems.
* Ability to travel occasionally to restaurants and catering facility locations.
* Ability to respond to emergency situations as needed.
* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.

**Work Environment**

* Primarily based at the Corporate Office.
* Regular interaction with restaurant management, catering operations teams, and corporate leadership.
* May require occasional after\-hours, weekends, or holiday availability to address security incidents or emergencies.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and monitor security operations across multiple sites to ensure compliance with safety protocols and regulations.
* Oversee the operation and maintenance of access control systems and surveillance equipment to prevent unauthorized access or breaches.
* Respond promptly to emergencies, including medical incidents requiring first aid or CPR, security breaches, or other critical situations.
* Write detailed incident reports and maintain accurate documentation of security activities for review and compliance purposes.
* Collaborate with Director of security department during investigations or incidents requiring external support.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in security operations, law enforcement, military service, or related fields.
* Knowledge of security systems, access control systems, surveillance technology, and emergency response procedures.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing teams in high\-pressure environments.
* Excellent communication skills for report writing, conflict management, and customer service interactions.
* Ability to perform physical security duties including heavy lifting when necessary.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite for documentation and operational management tasks.
* Certifications in first aid and CPR are highly desirable; additional training in law enforcement or operational management is a plus.

Join us as a Security Operations Coordinator to help create a safe environment while developing your leadership skills in a dynamic setting!

We are uniting industry\-leading solutions to build an integrated care model that holistically addresses an individual's physical, mental and social needs \- helping patients access and navigate care anytime and anywhere. As a team member of our Senior Community Care (SCC) team, we work with a team to provide care to patients at home in a nursing home, assisted living for senior housing. This life\-changing work adds a layer of support to improve access to care. We're connecting care to create a seamless health journey for patients across care settings. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

The Sales Account Manager (SAM) is a field\-based position charged with enrolling Medicare beneficiaries, residing in a skilled nursing facility into the UnitedHealthcare Institutional Special Needs Plan (ISNP).

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Utilize the national sales model to generate leads and enroll beneficiaries into the UnitedHealthcare Nursing Home plan

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Our Enterprise Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long\-term partner.

**Client Relationship Manager II**  

  

Job Description  

  

The Client Relationship Manager II is a strategic role focused on optimizing commercial fleet operations for national clients. This position drives client growth and retention through operational partnership, using industry expertise, data analysis, financial insight, and technology to align internal operations with client success.  

  

Maintenance management is a core function of Cox Fleet Operations, and this role supports that mission by leveraging data\-driven insights and technology to position the organization as a trusted advisor.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

* **Performance Monitoring:** Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), including federal inspection compliance, preventative maintenance, on\-road failures, and spend.
* **Data Analysis \& Reporting:** Use fleet management systems to generate insights and deliver actionable reports.
* **Strategic Planning:** Conduct regular client meetings, share performance metrics, and lead business reviews aligned with client objectives.
* **Client Management:** Serve as the primary point of contact, managing relationships and acting as escalation lead while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to meet client needs.
* **Communication:** Provide proactive updates on operations, service issues, and product enhancements; ensure transparency from issue identification through resolution.
* **Customer Experience:** Deliver high\-touch service, resolve issues efficiently, and consistently meet or exceed client expectations.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify gaps, recommend efficiencies, and support development and maintenance of programs, services, and SOPs.
* **Operational Oversight:** Monitor SLA performance, customer satisfaction, and audit results; ensure accurate documentation and adherence to procedural controls and reporting standards.
* **Leadership:** Lead client and internal calls, coordinate cross\-functional efforts, and report key concerns with recommended solutions.
* **Compliance:** Follow all corporate policies and procedures.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**  

* Bachelor's degree in Communication, Business Admin, and 2 years' experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master's degree and up to 2 years' experience, or 6 years' experience in a related field
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to quickly and effectively resolve client issues.
* Proven ability to manage complex client relationships and deliver high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Excellent communication skills, with a proactive and transparent approach to client engagement.
* Ability to analyze operational performance, identify gaps, and recommend process improvements.

  

Experience working with data, financial considerations, and technology to support operational and client success.  

  

USD 55,600\.00 \- 83,400\.00 per year

new_jobs.title: VA Regional Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
American Armor Gloves is hiring its first VA Regional Sales Representatives to build out a dedicated sales function for VA healthcare accounts. This is a new sales team, not a new company — AAG has spent years developing the manufacturing capacity, quality systems, and early government relationships this role is built to take advantage of.


**The Opportunity**
===================



This is a new role, but it isn't a cold start. AAG has already done much of the groundwork required to sell into government and VA healthcare: compliant manufacturing, a quality system built for regulated buyers, and early relationships with VA stakeholders. What hasn't existed until now is a dedicated sales representative to develop that opportunity fully within an assigned VA region. You'll be one of the first five or six people to hold this role, working from an established foundation rather than starting from nothing.


**What You'll Own**
===================


* Sales development and account management for VA facilities, CBOCs, and healthcare systems within your assigned region.
* Relationships with the people who make purchasing decisions — Chiefs of Logistics, procurement leads, and clinical stakeholders.
* A territory pipeline you build and manage yourself, from first contact through closed business, navigating VA purchasing processes along the way.
* Ongoing account growth, including new facility penetration and deeper relationships within your region.

**What Makes You the Right Fit**
================================


* **Government or VA sales experience — required.** You should already understand how these purchasing processes work.
* **Existing relationships within VA healthcare systems — preferred.** It's a specific, relationship\-driven network, and prior experience in it shortens the learning curve.
* **Comfort managing a defined territory independently,** with real ownership over how you prioritize and run it.
* **Strong follow\-through and CRM discipline,** since accurate pipeline and forecast tracking is a core part of the role, not an afterthought.

**Compensation \& Growth**
==========================



Base salary plus commission, structured to be competitive with current market data for government and federal healthcare sales roles, with uncapped upside as your territory develops. As AAG's government sales team grows, there is a defined path forward — into senior territory roles, national account management, and eventually broader federal healthcare opportunities beyond the VA.


**About American Armor Gloves**
===============================



American Armor Gloves manufactures high\-quality nitrile gloves, produced in West Columbia, South Carolina. The company has built its business on advanced manufacturing, operational discipline, and a commitment to quality — supplying healthcare professionals, first responders, and other essential workers who depend on consistent, reliable protection.


**We are actively interviewing for this role now — apply today to be considered.**

new_jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
You get to create, execute, and keep the work moving.  

  

Roadrunner is the most tech\-forward company in LTL. We built a proprietary Smart Network™ that delivers fewer touches, faster transit, real\-time visibility, and real accountability. The service is differentiated. The point of view is clear. Marketing has not yet fully translated that advantage into how the brand shows up every day—on the website, in social, in video, in events, and in the materials our teams use.  

  

That’s the opportunity. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you will be the creative force and operational backbone of the marketing team. You will design, film, write, organize, and ship. You will bring campaigns to life through compelling visual content, tight planning, and cross\-platform execution. You will keep initiatives on\-brand, on deadline, and running smoothly in a lean, PE\-backed environment that rewards ownership and speed.
**What you’ll do**
==================

**1\. Content Creation \& Brand Presence**
------------------------------------------


This is a creation role, not a maintenance role. You make the brand visible.

* Design and produce marketing materials using Canva and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) for digital and print campaigns.
* Invent and ship high\-impact visual content that advances Roadrunner as the Category of One—graphics, sales collateral, social assets, landing\-page visuals, event materials, and campaign creative.
* Create video and photo content. Appear on camera when needed and direct shoots that capture authentic customer stories, owner\-operator voices, and company culture.
* Support Roadrunner’s LinkedIn and social presence with content that is sharp, human, and on\-brand—not generic freight marketing.
* Shape how the brand shows up across digital, physical, and experiential touchpoints so every interaction reinforces that Roadrunner is leading the way.

**2\. Campaign Execution \& Coordination**
------------------------------------------


The Marketing Manager owns the strategy. You make the machine run.

* Coordinate with vendors, internal stakeholders, sales, talent acquisition, and the marketing team to execute multi\-channel campaigns on time.
* Support integrated campaigns across digital, social, email, content, events, and emerging channels that drive awareness, pipeline, and talent outcomes.
* Treat every campaign as an experiment. Track what shipped, what worked, and what needs to change. Document what you learn.
* Produce materials and communications for strategic customer accounts based on direction from leadership and the Marketing Manager.

**3\. Website, Social \& Digital Presence**
-------------------------------------------


Keep the public face of the brand fresh, usable, and current.

* Manage and update the website CMS so content is accurate, optimized, and user\-friendly.
* Support social media content creation and campaign execution across platforms—planning, producing, scheduling, and reporting.
* Help build and maintain landing pages and digital experiences that match Roadrunner’s voice and convert attention into action.
* Use AI tools to accelerate production without sacrificing quality, voice, or point of view.

**4\. Calendar, Systems \& Operational Support**
------------------------------------------------


You are the detail\-oriented backbone. Nothing falls through the cracks.

* Own the marketing calendar and project\-management systems. Keep deadlines visible. Keep work moving.
* Help maintain reusable content resources, brand guidelines, and AI prompt frameworks so internal teams can produce on\-brand materials without bottlenecks.
* Apply AI and automation to recurring production and administrative work—reducing manual effort and shortening turnaround time.
* Track marketing expenses and assist with budget reconciliation.
* Identify friction in how marketing work gets done, then fix it with process, templates, and tools that stick.

**5\. Talent, Owner\-Operator \& Culture Content**
--------------------------------------------------


Attract the right people. Help them stay. Make the culture visible.

* Produce recruitment marketing creative that attracts high\-quality CDL drivers, owner operators, and key employees.
* Create targeted assets and content for owner\-operator acquisition and retention campaigns.
* Partner with talent acquisition and operations to support employee recruiting with clear, compelling materials.
* Capture and produce culture content—photos, video, recognition assets, newsletter visuals—that reinforces We Run Safe. We Run Smart. We Run Together.
* Support internal communications with polished, on\-brand assets so employees and owner operators feel informed and seen.

**What you bring**
==================

* Proven experience in a marketing or related creative role, with a portfolio that shows you can make work, not only talk about it.
* Significant creative skill in Canva and comfort in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro).
* Confidence both in front of and behind the camera for video and photography.
* CMS experience and proven website management skills.
* Event marketing experience, especially direct customer engagement and activation.
* Experience creating content for social platforms and running work across multiple channels at once.
* Detail\-oriented process and project\-management muscle. You keep calendars, files, vendors, and deadlines tight.
* Strong writing and visual storytelling. You can make industrial and technology stories feel sharp and human.
* Comfort using AI tools to create, iterate, and scale content without losing quality or brand voice.
* Comfort operating in a lean, fast\-moving environment where you wear multiple hats and invent process as needed.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Great to have: HubSpot or similar marketing automation, Google Analytics,

**About Grubhub**

  

At Grubhub, we believe food is more than just a meal: It’s a source of discovery, connection, and pure enjoyment. There’s a time and place for every type of dish, from hidden neighborhood gems to tried\-and\-true favorites, and we exist to connect people with the food they love in all the ways they like to dig in. We’ve been at it since 2004, but now, as part of Wonder, Grubhub is operating with a renewed sense of momentum and the high\-velocity energy of a powerhouse startup.

  

As a leading U.S. ordering and delivery marketplace, we feature over 415,000 merchants in more than 4,000 cities, creating the ultimate food experience by elevating online ordering through innovative restaurant technology, easy\-to\-use platforms, and an improved delivery experience. We are constantly finding new ways to innovate—from integrated grocery delivery with groceries powered by Instacart to exclusive loyalty programs. Join our team, based out of New York City and Chicago, and help us give our diners the exceptional value they deserve.

 **The Impact You Will Make:**

* Develop a solid understanding of Grubhub's products and services, including their features, benefits, and value propositions.
* Assist in managing a portfolio of accounts, ensuring timely communication, and addressing basic inquiries or concerns from clients.
* Assist restaurants in attracting new diners, boosting order volume, and delivering top\-quality service to their diners.
* Conduct regular check\-ins with restaurant partners to gather feedback, assess satisfaction levels, and identify areas for improvement.
* Respond to restaurant inquiries, account issues, and requests or route them to appropriate company departments within turnaround time expectations.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of client interactions, including notes on discussions, action items, and follow\-up tasks.
* Participate in training sessions and workshops to enhance product knowledge, sales skills, and overall proficiency in account management practices.
* Proactively seek opportunities to contribute to team goals and initiatives, demonstrating a willingness to learn and grow in the role.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* Native\-level fluency in English is required. Candidates fluent in Mandarin or Spanish are strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of experience and High School degree/GED required
* 2\-4 years of Sales or Account Manager experience. Experience working with (or selling to) restaurant owners is a major plus. Restaurant experience is also a plus.
* Strong computer skills (MS Office, Google products) with the ability to quickly learn new software. Experience with Salesforce.com or similar CRM is a plus.
* Native\-level fluency in English is required. Candidates fluent in Mandarin or Spanish are strongly preferred.
* Ability and desire to do whatever it takes to find solutions for restaurants.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Confident making outbound dials on the phone.
* Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals.
* Impeccable organizational skills, easily balancing multiple tasks at once; self\-starter with a strong bias towards action and problem\-solving; maximizes effectiveness by focusing time in the right areas.
* Outstanding, positive attitude with passion and aptitude for working in a fast\-paced and fast\-growing environment.

**Our hybrid model requires 3 days a week in the office. That said, many team members choose to come in more often to take advantage of in\-person collaboration and connection. You're welcome—and encouraged—to be in the office up to 5 days a week if it works for you.**


We reward our Sales positions with competitive pay. For this role, we offer uncapped commission with a base salary range as outlined below.


New York: $70,400\- 88,000 ($88,000\-$110,000 OTE)


Illinois: $ 64,000 \- $80,000 ($80,000 \- $100,000 OTE)


Wonder uses geographic\-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

**Benefits**

  

The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non\-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands.

  

Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here.

 **A Final Note**

American Armor Gloves is hiring its first VA Regional Sales Representatives to build out a dedicated sales function for VA healthcare accounts. This is a new sales team, not a new company — AAG has spent years developing the manufacturing capacity, quality systems, and early government relationships this role is built to take advantage of.

===================



This is a new role, but it isn't a cold start. AAG has already done much of the groundwork required to sell into government and VA healthcare: compliant manufacturing, a quality system built for regulated buyers, and early relationships with VA stakeholders. What hasn't existed until now is a dedicated sales representative to develop that opportunity fully within an assigned VA region. You'll be one of the first five or six people to hold this role, working from an established foundation rather than starting from nothing.


**What You'll Own**
===================


* Sales development and account management for VA facilities, CBOCs, and healthcare systems within your assigned region.
* Relationships with the people who make purchasing decisions — Chiefs of Logistics, procurement leads, and clinical stakeholders.
* A territory pipeline you build and manage yourself, from first contact through closed business, navigating VA purchasing processes along the way.
* Ongoing account growth, including new facility penetration and deeper relationships within your region.

================================


* **Government or VA sales experience — required.** You should already understand how these purchasing processes work.
* **Existing relationships within VA healthcare systems — preferred.** It's a specific, relationship\-driven network, and prior experience in it shortens the learning curve.
* **Comfort managing a defined territory independently,** with real ownership over how you prioritize and run it.

==========================



Base salary plus commission, structured to be competitive with current market data for government and federal healthcare sales roles, with uncapped upside as your territory develops. American Armor Gloves manufactures high\-quality nitrile gloves, produced in West Columbia, South Carolina.
